# Biographies of the various Xiàhóu and Cáo

## Xiàhóu Dūn {.unnumbered #xiahoudun}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Xiàhóu Dūn appellation Yuánràng was a Pèi state Qiáo man, Xiàhóu Yīng's posterity.^[Xiàhóu Yīng was an early follower of Liú Bāng, founder of Former Hàn.] Aged fourteen, he joined a teacher to study, someone insulted his teacher, [Xiàhóu] Dūn killed him, because of this he was known for his fierce spirit. When Tàizǔ first rose, [Xiàhóu] Dūn always was his subordinate officer, following in campaigns. When Tàizǔ was Acting Exerting Warfare General, appointed [Xiàhóu] Dūn as his Major,^[Major (sīmǎ) was a chief of staff for military affairs.] separately garrisoned Báimǎ, promoted to Breaking Charge Colonel, designate Dōng prefecture Administrator.^[This appointment is perhaps notable in that this was Cáo Cāo's previous position before becoming Yǎn Province Governor.] When Tàizǔ campaigned against Táo Qiān, he left [Xiàhóu] Dūn to defend Púyáng. Zhāng Miǎo rebelled and welcomed Lǚ Bù, Tàizǔ's family was at Juànchéng, [Xiàhóu] Dūn with light army hurried there, happened to encounter [Lǚ] Bù, engaged in battle. [Lǚ] Bù retreated and returned, then entered Púyáng, surprise attacking and capturing [Xiàhóu] Dūn's military heavy supplies. Sent officers to falsely surrender, togethery they seized and held [Xiàhóu] Dūn, ransoming him for treasures, inside [Xiàhóu] Dūn's army was shaken and afraid. [Xiàhóu] Dūn's officer Hán Hào then organized troops to garrison [Xiàhóu] Dūn's camp gates, summoned the army clerks and various officers, restrained the armored to stay at their divisions and not move, the various camps were then settled. Then he visited where [Xiàhóu] Dūn was, shouted at the hostage takers stating: "You all vicious rebels, how dare you seize and hold the chief General, do you still hope to live? Moreover I have received mandate to suppress rebels, how can I because of a single General yet release you?" Then he shed tears and spoke to [Xiàhóu] Dūn stating: "What can be done about the state's law?" He hastily summoned troops to strike the hostage takers. The hostage takers were frightened and immediately bowed head,^[Bowed head (kòutóu) is to bow to press the forehead to the ground. The term is the source of the loan word "kowtow."] saying: "We only wished to beg for supplies to use to leave." [Hán] Hào severely rebuked them^[Another interpretation of "severely rebuked" (shù zé) is "counted and rebuked" or "numbered and rebuked," as in to list out all the charges and accusations against a criminal.] and beheaded them all. [Xiàhóu] Dūn was freed, Tàizǔ heard about this, spoke to [Hán] Hào stating: "You in this can be a model for all ages." Thus wrote order: "From now on afterward if there are hostage takers, all are to together strike, with no concern for hostages." Because of this the taking of hostages therefore ceased. <a href="#annotation-1" id="source-1">[1]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
夏侯惇字元讓，沛國譙人，夏侯嬰之後也。年十四，就師學，人有辱其師者，惇殺之，由是以烈氣聞。太祖初起，惇常為裨將，從征伐。太祖行奮武將軍，以惇為司馬，別屯白馬，遷折衝校尉，領東郡太守。太祖征陶謙，留惇守濮陽。張邈叛迎呂布，太祖家在鄄城，惇輕軍往赴，適與布會，交戰。布退還，遂入濮陽，襲得惇軍輜重。遣將偽降，共執持惇，責以寶貨，惇軍中震恐。惇將韓浩乃勒兵屯惇營門，召軍吏諸將，皆案甲當部不得動，諸營乃定。遂詣惇所，叱持質者曰：「汝等凶逆，乃敢執劫大將軍，復欲望生邪！且吾受命討賊，寧能以一將軍之故，而縱汝乎？」因涕泣謂惇曰：「當奈國法何！」促召兵擊持質者。持質者惶遽叩頭，言「我但欲乞資用去耳」！浩數責，皆斬之。惇既免，太祖聞之，謂浩曰：「卿此可為萬世法。」乃著令，自今已後有持質者，皆當并擊，勿顧質。由是劫質者遂絕〔一〕。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-1" id="annotation-1">[1]</a> Sūn Shèng states: Citing Guāng-Wǔ jì,^[Guāng-Wǔ jì is an annals of Later Hàn Emperor Guāng-Wǔ. However, this story does not appear in the now canonical annals of Guāng-Wǔ in Fàn Yè's Hòu Hàn shū 1, so Sūn Shèng is using a different history of Later Hàn. Fàn Yè's Hòu Hàn shū instead has the story in Hòu Hàn shū 10.] Jiànwǔ Ninth Year [33], bandits seized Noble Lady Yīn's mother and younger brother,^[Noble Lady (guìrén) was a rank in a harem. The term mǔ dì can also mean "younger brother of the same mother," but the account in Hòu Hàn shū 10 clarifies that both lady Yīn's mother and younger brother were taken hostage.] the clerks because they could not hold back on account of hostages pressured the bandits, and the bandits therefore killed them. That being the case a combined strike,^[In this context combined strike (hé jī) probably refers to attacking both hostages and hostage takers.] then was an ancient regulation. From Ān and Shùn on down,^[Emperor Ān of Hàn (r. 106 - 125) and Emperor Shùn of Hàn (r. 125 - 144).] government and education gradually declined, taking of important hostages did not avoid Kings and Dukes, but of the relevant managers none were able to observe and uphold state statutes. [Hán] Hào was the first to resume beheading them, therefore Wèi Wǔ commended him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　孫盛曰：案光武紀，建武九年，盜劫陰貴人母弟，吏以不得拘質迫盜，盜遂殺之也。然則合擊者，乃古制也。自安、順已降，政教陵遲，勢質不避王公，而有司莫能遵奉國憲者，浩始復斬之，故魏武嘉焉。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Tàizǔ from Xú Province returned, [Xiàhóu] Dūn followed the campaign against Lǚ Bù, was hit by a stray arrow, wounded in the left eye.^[From this context it is clear that Xiàhóu Dūn's eye wound occurred during the campaigns against Lǚ Bù in 194. However, the canonical annotations to the biography of Lǚ Bù in Hòu Hàn shū 75 cite this passage as part of a broader summary of Xiàhóu Dūn's career in connection to Xiàhóu Dūn being mentioned as participating of the campaign against Lǚ Bù in 198. This creates a false impression that Xiàhóu Dūn's eye wound occurred in the 198 campaign, and is probably the source for the incorrect myth that Xiàhóu Dūn's eye wound occurred in 198 perpetuated by Sān Guó Yǎnyì and other nonhistorical sources.] Further designated Chénliú and Jǐyīn Administrator,^[This appointment is perhaps notable in that Zhāng Miǎo had been Administrator of Chénliú, meaning that Xiàhóu Dūn was probably being entrusted to pacify the region that had been the heart of the rebellion against Cáo Cāo.] added Establishing Warfare General, enfeoffed Marquess of Gāo'ān village. At the time there was a great drought, locusts rising, [Xiàhóu] Dūn thus diverted the Tàishòu river to build a resevoir, personally carrying soil, leading the officers and servicemen to encourage planting of rice, the civilians depended on the benefits. Transferred to designate Hénán Intendant.^[This appointment is perhaps notable in that Hénán Intendant held censorial authority over central government positions. It is possible this appointment occurred around the same time that Cáo Cāo was appointed Director of Retainers Colonel, which also held censorial authority. Under normal administration, Hénán Intendant was the head of Hénán prefecture, which contained the capital city of Luòyáng, while Director of Retainers Colonel was the head of Sīlì, the province containing the capital city of Luòyáng.] When Tàizǔ pacified the Hé's north, he was the main army's rear guard. When Yè fell, promoted to Subduing Waves General,^[Subduing Waves General (fúbō jiāngjūn) was a Miscellaneous Title General that had been famously used for Lù Bódé during Former Hàn and for Mǎ Yuán during Later Hàn. It had more recently been used again for Chén Dēng. Xiàhóu Dūn's appointment probably was to succeed Chén Dēng, which a limit on Chén Dēng's death as occuring sometime before or during 204, as Chén Dēng's death year is not otherwise known.]  designate Intendant as before, enabled to handle affairs by circumstances and expedience, not restrained by standard regulations. Jiàn'ān Twelfth Year [207], noted [Xiàhóu] Dūn's beginning to end achievements, increased enfeoffment estate by one thousand eight hundred households, adding to the previous (to total) two thousand five hundred households. Twenty-first Year [216], followed the campaign against Sūn Quán and returned, sent [Xiàhóu] Dūn as Overall Supervisor of twenty-six armies, remaining at Jūcháo. Bestowed performers and musicians and famed singers, the Order said: "Wèi Jiàng for the achievement of making peace with the Róng yet received the music of metal and stone, all the more for you General!"^[From context, the reward of musicians and singers was to commemorate the achievement of Sūn Quán's formal surrender to have Xiàhóu Dūn's Jūcháo garrison removed. It was not a bestowal of "prostitues and female entertainers" as claimed by Lu Yimin in the utterly ridiculous PhD thesis "Talons and Fangs of the Eastern Han Warlords."] Twenty-fourth Year [219], Tàizǔ's army was at Móbēi, summoned [Xiàhóu] Dūn to regularly share the same carriage, especially met with intimacy and value, exiting and entering the inner rooms, of the various officers none could compare. Appointed Front General, <a href="#annotation-2" id="source-2">[2]</a> supervising the various armies to return to Shòuchūn, relocated garrison to Shàolíng. When Emperor Wén succeeded the King's throne, appointed [Xiàhóu] Dūn as General-in-Chief, in several moons he died. <a href="#annotation-3" id="source-3">[3]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖自徐州還，惇從征呂布，為流矢所中，傷左目。〔一〕復領陳留、濟陰太守，加建武將軍，封高安鄉侯。時大旱，蝗蟲起，惇乃斷太壽水作陂，身自負土，率將士勸種稻，民賴其利。轉領河南尹。太祖平河北，為大將軍後拒。鄴破，遷伏波將軍，領尹如故，使得以便宜從事，不拘科制。建安十二年，錄惇前後功，增封邑千八百戶，并前二千五百戶。二十一年，從征孫權還，使惇都督二十六軍，留居巢。賜伎樂名倡，令曰：「魏絳以和戎之功，猶受金石之樂，況將軍乎！」二十四年，太祖軍（擊破呂布軍）于摩陂，召惇常與同載，特見親重，出入臥內，諸將莫得比也。拜前將軍，〔二〕督諸軍還壽春，徙屯召陵。文帝即王位，拜惇大將軍，數月薨。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-2" id="annotation-2">[2]</a> Wèilüè states: At the time when Xiàhóu Yuān and Dūn both were Generals, inside the army called [Xiàhóu] Dūn as "Blind Xiàhóu." [Xiàhóu] Dūn hated this, on looking in a mirror would became enraged and always smash the mirror to the ground.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏略曰：時夏侯淵與惇俱為將軍，軍中號惇為盲夏侯。惇惡之，照鏡恚怒，輒撲鏡于地。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-3" id="annotation-3">[3]</a> Wèi shū states: At the time when the various officers all received Wèi official titles, [Xiàhóu] Dūn alone was a Hàn official, and so sent up a memorial himself explaining it was inappropriate to not follow the rituals of a servant.^[When Cáo Cāo became Duke of Wèi and later King of Wèi, Wèi officials formally became his subjects and would have to observe certain rituals of being servants to Cáo Cāo. Xiàhóu Dūn was being specially honored to not be a servant of Cáo Cāo and instead remain Cáo Cāo's peer with both of them being Hàn officials.] Tàizǔ said: "I have heard that the highest is to treat servants as teachers, the next is treat servants as friend, for a servant is someone valued for virtue. Trifling insignificant Wèi, yet is it enough to humble you to become a servant?" [Xiàhóu] Dūn firmly requested, and so was appointed as Front General.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：時諸將皆受魏官號，惇獨漢官，乃上疏自陳不當不臣之禮。太祖曰：「吾聞太上師臣，其次友臣。夫臣者，貴德之人也，區區之魏，而臣足以屈君乎？」惇固請，乃拜為前將軍。
:::
:::
:::

### Xiàhóu Mào {.unnumbered #xiahoumao}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Although [Xiàhóu] Dūn was in the army, he personally welcomed his teacher to receive education. By nature he was pure and frugal, when he had extra wealth he always divided and distributed it, when he did not have enough he supplied it from the government, not managing property or business. Posthumous name called Zhōng-hóu. His son [Xiàhóu] Chōng succeeded. The Emperor in recollection of [Xiàhóu] Dūn's achievements wished to have his sons and grandsons all be Marquesses, divided one thousand households from [Xiàhóu] Dūn's estate to bestow on seven sons and two grandsons of [Xiàhóu] Dūn noble titles all as Marquesses Within the Passes. [Xiàhóu] Dūn's younger brother [Xiàhóu] Lián and son [Xiàhóu] Mào already had their own enfeoffments as Ranked Marquesses. Previously, Tàizǔ had a daughter be wife to [Xiàhóu] Mào, who was the Qīnghé Princess. [Xiàhóu] Mào successively held position as Attendant Central, Secretariat Writer, Securing West and Defending East General, Lent Stave. <a href="#annotation-4" id="source-4">[4]</a> [Xiàhóu] Chōng died, his son [Xiàhóu] Yì succeeded. [Xiàhóu] Yì died, his son [Xiàhóu] Shào succeeded. <a href="#annotation-5" id="source-5">[5]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
惇雖在軍旅，親迎師受業。性清儉，有餘財輒以分施，不足資之於官，不治產業。諡曰忠侯。子充嗣。帝追思惇功，欲使子孫畢侯，分惇邑千戶，賜惇七子二孫爵皆關內侯。惇弟廉及子楙素自封列侯。初，太祖以女妻楙，即清河公主也。楙歷位侍中尚書、安西鎮東將軍，假節。〔一〕充薨，子廙嗣。廙薨，子劭嗣。〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-4" id="annotation-4">[4]</a> Wèi lüè states: [Xiàhóu] Mào appellation Zǐlín, [Xiàhóu] Dūn's middle son. Emperor Wén in youth was close with [Xiàhóu] Mào, on succeeding the throne, appointed him as Securing West General, Holding Stave, succeeding Xiàhóu Yuān's position as Overall Supervisor of Guānzhōng. [Xiàhóu] Mào by nature was without military strategy, but enjoyed making money. Reaching Tàihé Second Year [228], Emperor Míng campaigned west, someone reported on [Xiàhóu] Mào, therefore he was summoned to return and become a Secretariat Writer. In the time [Xiàhóu] Mào was in the west, he kept many entertainers and concubines, the princess because of this was not harmonious with [Xiàhóu] Mào. Then afterward his various younger brothers did not comply with ritual standards, [Xiàhóu] Mào repeatedly severely rebuked them, the younger brothers feared punishment, and so together framed [Xiàhóu] Mào with slander, having the princess memorialize against him. There was Edict to arrest [Xiàhóu] Mào. The Emperor's intention was to wish to kill him, and asked Cháng River Colonel Jīngzhào Duàn Mò about it, [Duàn] Mò believed: "This certainly is the Qīnghé Princess with [Xiàhóu] Mào not getting along, leading to slander and framing, hoping that the facts will not be investigated. Moreover the Subduing Waves with the Former Emperor had achievements in settling Heaven's Under, it is appropriate to apply reconsideration."^[Reconsideration here is sān sī, literally "three times thinking."] The Emperor's thoughts resolved, and he said: "I also believe it so." Thus issued Edict to investigate and interrogate who composed the memorial for the Princess, and indeed it framing by the younger brothers Zǐzāng and Zǐjiāng.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏略曰：楙字子林，惇中子也。文帝少與楙親，及即位，以為安西將軍、持節，承夏侯淵處都督關中。楙性無武略，而好治生。至太和二年，明帝西征，人有白楙者，遂召還為尚書。楙在西時，多畜伎妾，公主由此與楙不和。其後群弟不遵禮度，楙數切責，弟懼見治，乃共搆楙以誹謗，令主奏之，有詔收楙。帝意欲殺之，以問長水校尉京兆段默，默以為「此必清河公主與楙不睦，出于譖搆，冀不推實耳。且伏波與先帝有定天下之功，宜加三思」。帝意解，曰：「吾亦以為然。」乃發詔推問為公主作表者，果其群弟子臧、子江所搆也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-5" id="annotation-5">[5]</a> Jìn Yángqiū states: Tàishǐ Second Year [266], Marquess of Gāo'ān village Xiàhóu Zuǒ died, [Xiàhóu] Dūn's grandson, succession extinct. Edict said: "[Xiàhóu] Dūn was of Wèi's foundational achievement, accomplishments written on bamboo and silk. In the past Tíngjiān had no sacrifices, yet some mourned him, all the more for We who received the abdication from Wèi, yet can I forget its accomplished ministers? It is appropriate to select [Xiàhóu] Dūn's close relatives to honor^[It is also possible that the word here is the personal name Shào, as in "select Dūn's close relative [Xiàhóu] Shào and enfeoff him," but this interpretation is uncertain as there is no other record of a Xiàhóu Shào.] and enfeoff them."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　晉陽秋曰：泰始二年，高安鄉侯夏侯佐卒，惇之孫也，嗣絕。詔曰：「惇，魏之元功，勳書竹帛。昔庭堅不祀，猶或悼之，況朕受禪于魏，而可以忘其功臣哉！宜擇惇近屬劭封之。」
:::
:::
:::

### Hán Hào, Shǐ Huàn {.unnumbered #hanhao #shihuan}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Hán Hào was a Hénèi man. Pèi state's Shǐ Huàn with [Hán] Hào both were prominent for loyalty and valor. [Hán] Hào reached Central Protector of the Army, [Shǐ] Huàn reached Central Manager of the Army, both handling the Restricted Troops, enfeoffed Ranked Marquesses. <a href="#annotation-6" id="source-6">[6]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
韓浩者，河內人。（及）沛國史渙與浩俱以忠勇顯。浩至中護軍，渙至中領軍，皆掌禁兵，封列侯。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-6" id="annotation-6">[6]</a> Wèi shū states: Hán Hào appellation Yuánsì. At Hàn's end troops rose, his county was near mountains and marshes, with many bandits, [Hán] Hào assembled follower multitudes to be the county's screen defense. Administrator Wáng Kuāng appointed him a Following Official, commanded troops to resist Dǒng Zhuó at Méngjīn. At the time [Hán] Hào's mother's brother Dù Yáng was Héyīn Magistrate, [Dǒng] Zhuó seized him and had him summon [Hán] Hào, [Hán] Hào did not comply. Yuán Shù heard and admired his courage, appointed him Cavalry Commandant. Xiàhóu Dūn heard of his reputation, invited him to a meeting, was greatly impressed with him, having him manage troops and follow on campaign. At the time of a great discussion on modifications,^[the term sūn yì literally means "decreases and increases," referring to what policies to abandon or adopt.] [Hán] Hào believed farming should be urgent. Tàizǔ praised this, promoted to Protector of the Army. Tàizǔ wished to suppress Liǔchéng, Manager of the Army Shǐ Huàn believed the road was distant and deeply penetrating, not a secure plan, and wished to with [Hán] Hào together remonstrate. [Hán] Hào said: "Now the troop momentum is strong and flourishing, prestige applied on the Four Seas, in battle victories and in attacking seizing, nothing not as intended. To not as this time then eliminate the troubles of Heaven's Under, it will become a later concern. Moreover his Excellency is divinely martial, in every action without omissions in strategy, you and I are the Central Army's managers, and should not discourage the multitudes." Therefore followed in defeating Liǔchéng, changed his office to Central Protector of the Army, installing a Chief Clerk and Major. Followed in suppressing Zhāng Lǔ, [Zhāng] Lǔ surrendered. Commentators believed that [Hán] Hào's wisdom and strategy were sufficient to calm the borders, and wished to have him remain to serve as Overall Supervisor of the various armies to defend Hànzhōng. Tàizǔ said: "How can I be without my Protector of the Army?" Thus they returned together. He met with trusted appointment like this. When he died, Tàizǔ mourned and regretted losing him. No sons, had his adopted son Róng succeed him. Shǐ Huàn appellation Gōngliú. As a youth he was a vigilante, having heroic spirit. When Tàizǔ first rose, as a retainer he followed, Acted as Central Army Colonel, followed on campaign, always overseeing the various officers, meeting with close trust, transferred appointment to Central Manager of the Army. Fourteenth Year [209] he died. His son [Shǐ] Jìng succeeded.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：韓浩字元嗣。漢末起兵，縣近山藪，多寇，浩聚徒眾為縣藩衛。太守王匡以為從事，將兵拒董卓于盟津。時浩舅杜陽為河陰令，卓執之，使招浩，浩不從。袁術聞而壯之，以為騎都尉。夏侯惇聞其名，請與相見，大奇之，使領兵從征伐。時大議損益，浩以為當急田。太祖善之，遷護軍。太祖欲討柳城，領軍史渙以為道遠深入，非完計也，欲與浩共諫。浩曰：「今兵勢彊盛，威加四海，戰勝攻取，無不如志，不以此時遂除天下之患，將為後憂。且公神武，舉無遺策，吾與君為中軍主，不宜沮眾。」遂從破柳城，改其官為中護軍，置長史、司馬。從討張魯，魯降。議者以浩智略足以綏邊，欲留使都督諸軍，鎮漢中。太祖曰：「吾安可以無護軍？」乃與俱還。其見親任如此。及薨，太祖愍惜之。無子，以養子榮嗣。史渙字公劉。少任俠，有雄氣。太祖初起，以客從，行中軍校尉，從征伐，常監諸將，見親信，轉拜中領軍。十四年薨。子靜嗣。
:::
:::
:::

## Xiàhóu Yuān {.unnumbered #xiahouyuan}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Xiàhóu Yuān appellation Miàocái was [Xiàhóu] Dūn's younger third cousin.^[The term zú dì usually refers to a younger third cousin of the same male-line clan. First or second cousins of the same male-line clan are cóng dì.] When Tàizǔ was residing at home, he once had a county government problem, [Xiàhóu] Yuān took his place to take heavy punishment, Tàizǔ worked to rescue him, able to escape. <a href="#annotation-7" id="source-7">[7]</a> When Tàizǔ raised troops, became a Separate Division Major, Cavalry Commandant Follower, moved to Chénliú and Yǐngchuān Administrator. Reaching to the battle with Yuán Shào at Guāndù, he was Acting Supervisor Army Colonel. When [Yuán] Shào was defeated, sent to supervise Yǎn, Yù, Xú province's army provisions. At the time the army's food was few, [Xiàhóu] Yuān transferred the supplies continuously, the army was by this restored and roused. When Chāng Xī rebelled, sent Yú Jīn to strike him, had not yet taken him, further sent [Xiàhóu] Yuān to with [Yú] Jīn join forces, therefore struck [Chāng] Xī, subdued over ten garrisons, [Chāng] Xī went to [Yú] Jīn to surrender. [Xiàhóu] Yuān returned, appointed Organizing Army Colonel. <a href="#annotation-8" id="source-8">[8]</a> Jǐnán's and Lè'ān's Huángjīn Xú Hé and Sīmǎ Jù and others attacked cities, killed Chief Clerks, [Xiàhóu] Yuān commanded Tàishān, Qí, and Píngyuán prefecture troops to strike, greatly defeated them, beheaded [Xú] Hé, pacified the various counties, collected their provisions and grain to supply the army servicemen. Fourteenth Year [209], appointed [Xiàhóu] Yuān as Acting Manager of the Army.^[Xiàhóu Yuān may have been succeeding Shǐ Huàn, who is noted to have died in that year.] When Tàizǔ campaigned against Sūn Quán and returned, sent [Xiàhóu] Yuān to supervise the various officers in striking Lújiāng's rebelling Léi Xù, [Léi] Xù was defeated, also as Acting Campaigning West Protector of the Army supervised Xú Huǎng in striking Tàiyuán rebels, attacked and subdued over twenty garrisons, beheaded rebel leader Shāng Yào, slaughtered his city. Followed in campaigning against Hán Suì and the rest, battled at Wèinán. Also supervised Zhū Líng in pacifying the Yúmí and Qiān Dī.^[Yúmí and Qiān counties were in Yòufúfēng. The Dī were a foreign tribal people to the west.] With Tàizǔ met at Āndìng, subdued Yáng Qiū.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
夏侯淵字妙才，惇族弟也。太祖居家，曾有縣官事，淵代引重罪，太祖營救之，得免。〔一〕太祖起兵，以別部司馬、騎都尉從，遷陳留、潁川太守。及與袁紹戰于官渡，行督軍校尉。紹破，使督兗、豫、徐州軍糧；時軍食少，淵傳饋相繼，軍以復振。昌狶反，遣于禁擊之，未拔，復遣淵與禁并力，遂擊狶，降其十餘屯，狶詣禁降。淵還，拜典軍校尉。〔二〕濟南、樂安黃巾徐和、司馬俱等攻城，殺長吏，淵將泰山、齊、平原郡兵擊，大破之，斬和，平諸縣，收其糧穀以給軍士。十四年，以淵為行領軍。太祖征孫權還，使淵督諸將擊廬江叛者雷緒，緒破，又行征西護軍，督徐晃擊太原賊，攻下二十餘屯，斬賊帥商曜，屠其城。從征韓遂等，戰於渭南。又督朱靈平隃糜、汧氐。與太祖會安定，降楊秋。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-7" id="annotation-7">[7]</a> Wèi lüè states: At the time Yǎn and Yù were in great chaos, [Xiàhóu] Yuān due to starvation and scarcity abandoned his youngest son to save the life of his deceased younger brother's orphaned daughter.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏略曰：時兗、豫大亂，淵以饑乏，棄其幼子，而活亡弟孤女。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-8" id="annotation-8">[8]</a> Wèi shū states: [Xiàhóu] Yuān as a commander hastened to emergencies with speed, always setting out where the enemy did not expect, therefore inside the army for it made a saying stating: "Organizing Army Colonel Xiàhóu Yuān, three days five hundred, six days one thousand."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：淵為將，赴急疾，常出敵之不意，故軍中為之語曰：「典軍校尉夏侯淵，三日五百，六日一千。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Seventeenth Year [212], Tàizǔ then returned to Yè, appointed [Xiàhóu] Yuān as Acting Protector of the Army General, supervising Zhū Líng and Lù Zhāo and others to garrison Cháng'ān, struck and defeated Nánshān bandit Liú Xióng, subduing his multitudes. Besieged [Hán] Suì's and [Mǎ] Chāo's remnant faction Liáng Xīng at Hù,^[Hù county was in Yòufúfēng.] captured it, beheaded [Liáng] Xīng, enfeoffed as Marquess of Bóchāng precinct. Mǎ Chāo beseiged Liáng Province Inspector Wéi Kāng at Jì,^[Jì county was in Hànyáng/Tiānshuǐ prefecture.] [Xiàhóu] Yuān went to rescue [Wéi] Kāng, had not yet arrived, [Wéi] Kāng was destroyed. Over two hundred lǐ away from Jì, [Mǎ] Chāo came to oppose in battle, the army was not successful. Qiān's Dī rebelled, [Xiàhóu] Yuān withdrew the army to return. Nineteenth Year [214], Zhào Qú, Yǐn Fèng and others plotted to suppress [Mǎ] Chāo, Jiāng Xù raised troops at Lǔchéng^[Lǔchéng was in Yànmén prefecture] to support them. [Zhào] Qú and the rest deceitful advised [Mǎ] Chāo to have him go out to strike [Jiāng] Xù, and to the rear completely killed [Mǎ] Chāo's wife and children. [Mǎ] Chāo fled to Hànzhōng, returned to besiege Qíshān.^[Qíshān was in Hànyáng/Tiānshuǐ prefecture, near Xī county.] [Jiāng] Xù and the rest urgently requested rescue, the various officers that discussed wished to wait for Tàizǔ's directives. [Xiàhóu] Yuān said: "His Excellency as at Yè, back and forth is four thousand lǐ, by the time of reply, [Jiāng] Xù and the rest will certainly be destroyed. This is not to attack an emergency." Therefore he went, sent Zhāng Hé to supervise infantry and cavalry of five thousand at the front, from Chéncāng's narrow roads entering, [Xiàhóu] Yuān personally supervised provisions at the rear. [Zhāng] Hé reached the Wèi river's upstream, [Mǎ] Chāo commanded Dī and Qiāng of several thousand to oppose [Zhāng] Hé. Not yet battled, [Mǎ] Chāo fled, [Zhāng] Hé advanced the army to collect [Mǎ] Chāo's army equipment. [Xiàhóu] Yuān arrived, the various counties all had already surrendered. Hán Suì was at Xiǎnqīn,^[Xiǎnqīn county was in Hànyáng/Tiānshuǐ prefecture.] [Xiàhóu] Yuān wished to surprise attack and take him, [Hán] Suì fled. [Xiàhóu] Yuān collected [Hán] Suì's army provisions, pursued reaching to Lüèyáng city,^[Lüèyáng county was in Hànyáng/Tiānshuǐ prefecture.] away from [Hán] Suì by over twenty lǐ, the various officers wished to attack him, some said they should attack Xīngguó's Dī.^[Xīngguó was in Lüèyáng county.] [Xiàhóu] Yuān believed: "[Hán] Suì's troops are elite, Xīngguó city firm, attacking them they cannot quickly be taken, it is not as good as striking Chánglí's various Qiāng.^[Chánglí was in Lüèyáng county.] Chánglí's various Qiāng have many in [Hán] Suì's army, they will certainly return to rescue their families. If he abandons the Qiāng and defends alone then he is isolated, if he rescues Chánglí then the government troops will obtain an open battle, and he can certainly be taken." [Xiàhóu] Yuān thus left a supervising officer to defend the heavy supplies, light troops of infantry and cavalry arrived at Chánglí, attacked and burned the Qiāng garrisons, the killed and captured extremely many. The various Qiāng that were in [Hán] Suì's army each returned to their tribes. [Hán] Suì indeed rescued Chánglí, with [Xiàhóu] Yuān's army opposing in formation. The various officers saw [Hán] Suì's multitudes, feared it, and wished to join camps and make moats and then battle with them. [Xiàhóu] Yuān said: "We have turned and fought over a thousand lǐ, now to further build camps and moats, then the servicemen multitudes will be exhausted, and cannot last long. Although the rebels are many, they are easy to deal with." Thus he sounded the drums, greatly defeated [Hán] Suì's army, captured his banners and signal flag, returned to Lüèyáng, advanced the army to besiege Xīngguó. Dī King Qiānwàn fled to Mǎ Chāo, the remaining multitudes surrendered. Turned to strike Gāopíng's Túgè,^[Gāopíng county was in Āndìng prefecture.] all scattered and fled, collected their provisions and grain and oxen and horses. Thus Lent to [Xiàhóu] Yuān Stave.^[The Stave (jié) granted authority to act as an Imperial agent, only submitting a report after acting. The qualifier Lent (jiǎ) was due to the authority being temporary and revocable.]
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十七年，太祖乃還鄴，以淵行護軍將軍，督朱靈、路招等屯長安，擊破南山賊劉雄，降其眾。圍遂、超餘黨梁興於鄠，拔之，斬興，封博昌亭侯。馬超圍涼州刺史韋康於冀，淵救康，未到，康敗。去冀二百餘里，超來逆戰，軍不利。汧氐反，淵引軍還。十九年，趙衢、尹奉等謀討超，姜敘起兵鹵城以應之。衢等譎說超，使出擊敘，於後盡殺超妻子。超奔漢中，還圍祁山。敘等急求救，諸將議者欲須太祖節度。淵曰：「公在鄴，反覆四千里，比報，敘等必敗，非攻急也。」遂行，使張郃督步騎五千在前，從陳倉狹道入，淵自督糧在後。郃至渭水上，超將氐羌數千逆郃。未戰，超走，郃進軍收超軍器械。淵到，諸縣皆已降。韓遂在顯親，淵欲襲取之，遂走。淵收遂軍糧，追至略陽城，去遂二十餘里，諸將欲攻之，或言當攻興國氐。淵以為遂兵精，興國城固，攻不可卒拔，不如擊長離諸羌。長離諸羌多在遂軍，必歸救其家。若〔捨〕羌獨守則孤，救長離則官兵得與野戰，可必虜也。淵乃留督將守輜重，輕兵步騎到長離，攻燒羌屯，斬獲甚眾。諸羌在遂軍者，各還種落。遂果救長離，與淵軍對陳。諸將見遂眾，惡之，欲結營作塹乃與戰。淵曰：「我轉鬥千里，今復作營塹，則士眾罷弊，不可久。賊雖眾，易與耳。」乃鼓之，大破遂軍，得其旌麾，還略陽，進軍圍興國。氐王千萬逃奔馬超，餘眾降。轉擊高平屠各，皆散走，收其糧穀牛馬。乃假淵節。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, Fūhǎn's Sòng Jiàn took advantage of Liáng province's chaos, declaring himself Hěshǒu Pacifying Hàn King.^[Hěshǒu "head of the Hé" refers to the source of the Huáng Hé, or Yellow River. The term Pacifying Hàn (Píng Hàn) can also be understood as "Equal to Hàn," though this interpretation seems less likely.] Tàizǔ sent [Xiàhóu] Yuān to lead the various officers to supress [Sòng] Jiàn. [Xiàhóu] Yuān arrived, besieged Fūhǎn,^[Fūhǎn county was in Lǒngxī prefecture.] in over a moon captured it, beheaded [Sòng] Jiàn and his installed Assistant Chancellor on down. [Xiàhóu] Yuān separately sent Zhāng Hé and others to pacify Héguān,^[Héguān county was in Lǒngxī prefecture.] crossed the Hé to enter Xiǎohuángzhōng,^[Xiǎohuángzhōng was on the border between Xīpíng and Jīnchéng prefectures.] Héxī's various Qiāng completely surrendered, Lǒngyòu was pacified.^[Héxī refers generically to the area west of the upper courses of the Hé/Yellow River, Lǒngyòu refers generically to the areas west of Lǒng mountain. The territory of Liáng province was sometimes informally classified into these two subdivisions.] Tàizǔ sent down Order that said: "Sòng Jiàn created chaos and rebellion for over thirty years, [Xiàhóu] Yuān in one move exterminated him, a tiger striding west of the passes, wherever he advances none withstands. Zhòngní had a saying: 'You and I do not compare.'^[This is a reference to Lúnyǔ 5.9.]" Twenty-First Year [216], increased his fief by three hundred households, adding to the previous to total eight hundred households. Returned to strike Wǔdū's Dī and Qiāng at Xiàbiàn,^[Xiàbiàn county was in Wǔdū prefecture.] collected Dī grain of over ten thousand hú. Tàizǔ campaigned west gainst Zhāng Lǔ, [Xiàhóu] Yuān and the rest led Liáng Province's various officers and Marquesses and Kings on down to meet with Tàizǔ at Xiūtíng.^[Xiūtíng or Xiū precinct was in Qiān county in Yòufúfēng.] Every time Tàizǔ invited and met Qiāng or Hú, he had [Xiàhóu] Yuān to frighten them. It happened that [Zhāng] Lǔ surrendered, Hànzhōng was pacified, appointed [Xiàhóu] Yuān as Acting Overall Protector General, supervising Zhāng Hé, Xú Huǎng and others in pacifying Bā prefecture. Tàizǔ returned to Yè, left [Xiàhóu] Yuān to defend Hànzhōng, at once appointed [Xiàhóu] Yuān as Campaigning West General. Twenty-Third Year [218], Liú Bèi's army stationed Yángpíng Pass, [Xiàhóu] Yuān led the various officers to resist him, locked together for successive years. Twenty-Fourth Year Standard Moon [219 Feb 3 - Mar 3], [Liú] Bèi in the night burned the encircling abatis.^[Abatis (lùjiǎo), literally "deer horns," were a field defense made from cut down trees with sharpened branches and wood facing the enemy.] [Xiàhóu] Yuān sent Zhāng Hé to protect the east perimeter, personally commanded light troops to protect the south perimeter. [Liú] Bèi provoked [Zhāng] Hé to battle, [Zhāng] Hé's army was not successful. [Xiàhóu] Yuān divided his commanded troops to send half to assist [Zhāng] Hé. Surprise attacked by [Liú] Bèi, [Xiàhóu] Yuān therefore died in battle. Posthumous name Mǐn-hóu.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，枹罕宋建因涼州亂，自號河首平漢王。太祖使淵帥諸將討建。淵至，圍枹罕，月餘拔之，斬建及所置丞相已下。淵別遣張郃等平河關，渡河入小湟中，河西諸羌盡降，隴右平。太祖下令曰：「宋建造為亂逆三十餘年，淵一舉滅之，虎步關右，所向無前。仲尼有言：『吾與爾不如也。』」二十一年，增封三百戶，并前八百戶。還擊武都氐羌下辯，收氐穀十餘萬斛。太祖西征張魯，淵等將涼州諸將侯王已下，與太祖會休亭。太祖每引見羌、胡，以淵畏之。會魯降，漢中平，以淵行都護將軍，督張郃、徐晃等平巴郡。太祖還鄴，留淵守漢中，即拜淵征西將軍。二十三年，劉備軍陽平關，淵率諸將拒之，相守連年。二十四年正月，備夜燒圍鹿角。淵使張郃護東圍，自將輕兵護南圍。備挑郃戰，郃軍不利。淵分所將兵半助郃，為備所襲，淵遂戰死。諡曰愍侯。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, although [Xiàhóu] Yuān was repeatedly victorious in battle, Tàizǔ always warned him stating: "As a commander there are times of being timid and weak, and cannot only rely on valor. A commander should use valor as the foundation but enact it by intelligence and planning. To only know to use valor is to only be a match for a single common fellow."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，淵雖數戰勝，太祖常戒曰：「為將當有怯弱時，不可但恃勇也。將當以勇為本，行之以智計；但知任勇，一匹夫敵耳。」
:::
:::

### Xiàhóu Bà {.unnumbered #xiahouba}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Xiàhóu] Yuān's wife was Tàizǔ's wife's younger sister. Eldest son [Xiàhóu] Héng was bestowed Tàizǔ's younger brother Marquss Āi of Hǎiyáng's daughter, grace and favor especially expansive. [Xiàhóu] Héng inherited the noble title, transferred fief to Marquess of Ānníng precinct. During Huángchū [220 - 226], bestowed on middle son [Xiàhóu] Bà, and during Tàihé [227 - 233] bestowed on four of [Xiàhóu] Bà's younger brothers noble titles all as Marquesses Inside the Passes. 【Xiàhóu] Bà during Zhèngshǐ [240 - 248] was Suppressing Shǔ Protector of the Army and Right General, advanced in fief to Marquess of Bóchāng precinct, previously was generously treated by Cáo Shuǎng. On hearing of [Cáo] Shuǎng's execution, doubted his own position, and fled to enter Shǔ. Due to [Xiàhóu] Yuān's old achievements, spared [Xiàhóu] Bà's children, exiled to Lèlàng prefecture. <a href="#annotation-9" id="source-9">[9]</a> [Xiàhóu] Bà's younger brother [Xiàhóu] Wēi's office reached Yǎn Province Inspector. <a href="#annotation-10" id="source-10">[10]</a> [Xiàhóu] Wèi's younger brother [Xiàhóu] Huì Lè'ān Administrator, <a href="#annotation-11" id="source-11">[11]</a> [Xiàhóu] Huì's younger brother [Xiàhóu] Hé, Hénǎn Intendant. <a href="#annotation-12" id="source-12">[12]</a> [Xiàhóu] Héng died, his son [Xiàhóu] Jì succeeded, became Tiger Elite Central Cadet General. [Xiàhóu] Jì died, his son [Xiàhóu] Bāo succeeded.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
淵妻，太祖內妹。長子衡，尚太祖弟海陽哀侯女，恩寵特隆。衡襲爵，轉封安寧亭侯。黃初中，賜中子霸，太和中，賜霸四弟，爵皆關內侯。霸，正始中為討蜀護軍右將軍，進封博昌亭侯，素為曹爽所厚。聞爽誅，自疑，亡入蜀。以淵舊勳赦霸子，徙樂浪郡。〔一〕霸弟威，官至兗州刺史。〔二〕威弟惠，樂安太守。〔三〕惠弟和，河南尹。〔四〕衡薨，子績嗣，為虎賁中郎將。績薨，子褒嗣。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-9" id="annotation-9">[9]</a> Wèi lüè states: [Xiàhóu] Bà appellation Zhòngquán. [Xiàhóu] Yuān was killed by Shǔ, therefore [Xiàhóu] Bà always gnashed his teeth (in anger), wishing to take revenge on Shǔ. During Huángchū [220 - 226] became an Auxiliary General. In the Zǐwǔ campaign, [Xiàhóu] Bà was summoned to be the vanguard, advanced to reach Xīngshì's perimeter, secure camp inside Qū valley. The Shǔ men looked out and knew it was [Xiàhóu] Bà, directed to send down troops to attack him. [Xiàhóu] Bà personally battle amid the abatis, fortunately rescued arrive and only after was it resolved. Later he became Right General, garrisoned Lǒngxī, he nurtured the servicemen and harmonized with the Róng, all obtaining their pleased hearts. Reaching to during Zhèngshǐ, he succeeded Xiàhóu Rú as Campaigning against Shǔ Protector of the Army, subordinate to the Campaigning West. At the time the Campaigning West General was Xiàhóu Xuán, who was a cousin's son of [Xiàhóu] Bà, and [Xiàhóu] Xuán to Cáo Shuăng was a younger maternal cousin. When Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng executed Cáo Shuǎng, he then summoned [Xiàhóu] Xuán, [Xiàhóu] Xuán came east. [Xiàhóu] Bà heard that Cáo Shuǎng had been executed and [Xiàhóu] Xuán also had been summoned, believed disaster would certainly turn to reach him, his heart was internally afraid. Also [Xiàhóu] Bà formerly with Yōng Province Inspector Guō Huái had not been harmonious, and [Guō] Huái succeeded [Xiàhóu] Xuán as Campaigning West, [Xiàhóu] Bà was especially not at ease, and therefore then fled to Shǔ. He hurried south to Yīnpíng and lost his way, entered a deserted valley, his provisions were exhausted, he killed his horse and walked on foot, his feet were broken, he lied below a stone cliff and sent someone to find road, not knowing where to go. Shǔ heard of this, and so sent someone to welcome [Xiàhóu] Bà. Previously, in Jiàn'ān Fifth Year [200], at the time [Xiàhóu] Bà's younger female cousin was aged thirteen to fourteen, at her home prefecture, went out to collect firewood, and was captured by Zhāng Fēi. [Zhāng] Fēi knew she was the daughter of a good family and therefore made her his wife, she begat a daughter, who became Liú Shàn's Imperial Empress. Therefore when [Xiàhóu] Yuān had first died, [Zhāng] Fēi's wife requested and buried him. Reaching to [Xiàhóu] Bà entering Shǔ, [Liú] Shàn met with him, explained to him stating: "Your father came to harm in the battle lines, not by the hand and blade of my ancestors." He pointed at his son to show him stating: "This is the Xiàhóu clan's sister's son." Generously applied noble title and favor.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏略曰：霸字仲權。淵為蜀所害，故霸常切齒，欲有報蜀意。黃初中為偏將軍。子午之役，霸召為前鋒，進至興勢圍，安營在曲谷中。蜀人望知其是霸也，指下兵攻之。霸手戰鹿角間，賴救至，然後解。後為右將軍，屯隴西，其養士和戎，並得其歡心。至正始中，代夏侯儒為征蜀護軍，統屬征西。時征西將軍夏侯玄，於霸為從子，而玄於曹爽為外弟。及司馬宣王誅曹爽，遂召玄，玄來東。霸聞曹爽被誅而玄又徵，以為禍必轉相及，心既內恐；又霸先與雍州刺史郭淮不和，而淮代玄為征西，霸尤不安，故遂奔蜀。南趨陰平而失道，入窮谷中，糧盡，殺馬步行，足破，臥巖石下，使人求道，未知何之。蜀聞之，乃使人迎霸。初，建安五年，時霸從妹年十三四，在本郡，出行樵採，為張飛所得。飛知其良家女，遂以為妻，產息女，為劉禪皇后。故淵之初亡，飛妻請而葬之。及霸入蜀，禪與相見，釋之曰：「卿父自遇害於行閒耳，非我先人之手刃也。」指其兒子以示之曰：「此夏侯氏之甥也。」厚加爵寵。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-10" id="annotation-10">[10]</a> Shìyǔ states: [Xiàhóu] Wēi appellation Jìquán acted as a vigilante, successively was Inspector of Jīng and Yǎn two provinces. His son [Xiàhóu] Jùn was Bìng Province Inspector, the next [Xiàhóu] Zhuāng was Huáinán Administrator. [Xiàhóu] Zhuāng's son [Xiàhóu] Zhàn appellation Xiàoruò, for talent and broad learning and literary ability reached Nányáng Chancellor, Cavalier Regular Attendant. [Xiàhóu] Zhuāng was Jìn's Imperial Empress Jǐng-Yáng's elder sister's husband. Because of this the entirely was extravagantly prosperous at the time.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　世語曰：威字季權，任俠。貴歷荊、兗二州刺史。子駿，并州刺史。次莊，淮南太守。莊子湛，字孝若，以才博文章，至南陽相、散騎常侍。莊，晉景陽皇后姊夫也。由此一門侈盛於時。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-11" id="annotation-11">[11]</a> Wénzhāng Xù lù states: [Xiàhóu] Huì appellation Zhìquán, as a youth for talent and learning met with praise, excelled in composing memorials and discussions. Successively was Cavalier Yellow Gate Attendant Cadet, with Zhōng Yù repeatedly had debates and refutations, in many matters he was followed. Promoted to Yān Chancellor, Lè'ān Administrator. Aged thirty-seven he died.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　文章敘錄曰：惠字稚權，幼以才學見稱，善屬奏議。歷散騎黃門侍郎，與鍾毓數有辯駮，事多見從。遷燕相、樂安太守。年三十七卒。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-12" id="annotation-12">[12]</a> Shìyǔ states: [Xiàhóu] Hé appellation Yìquán in pure debate had talent in discourse. Successively was Hénán Intendant, Minister of Ceremonies.

[Xiàhóu] Yuān's third son [Xiàhóu] Chēng, fifth son [Xiàhóu] Róng, their collatoral grandson [Xiàhóu] Zhàn made an account of them stating: [Xiàhóu] Chēng appellation Shūquán. From childhood he enjoyed assembling boys anbd becoming their leader, when playing always was in affairs of armies and battle formations, if any violated orders he immediately whipped and beat them, of the multitudes none dare oppose him. [Xiàhóu] Yuān was secretly amazed with him, and had him read the Biography of Xiàng Yǔ and military books, he would not agree, stating: "If I am capable then I will act on my own, how can I learn from others?" Aged sixteen, he and [Xiàhóu] Yuān were hunting, they saw a running tiger, [Xiàhóu] Chēng galloped his horse to pursue it, he was prohibited but could not be stopped, and in one arrow it was felled. His reputation was heard of by Tàizǔ, Tàizǔ grasped his hand and was pleased and said: "I've obtained you!" With Emperor Wén he had plain clothes friendship, at every feast gathering, his spirit domianted the entire assembly, debating scholars could not subdue him. Of the highly famed of the world many followed his roaming, aged eighteen he died. His younger brother [Xiàhóu] Róng appellation Yòuquán, in youth was intelligent and perceptive, at seven years able to compose prose, recite texts of a thousand words a day, anything passing his eyes he at once remembered it. Emperor Wén heard of this and invited him. The guests were over a hundred people, each person presented a card, completely writing their homeland and personal name and clan, what the era calls a nobility title and homeland card. The guests showed him, with one glance, they had him talk with them all, and he did not mistake in a single person. The Emperor was deeply amazed with him. In the Hànzhōng campaign, [Xiàhóu] Róng was aged thirteen, the Left and Right carried him to flee, he would not agree, stating: "When lord or parent is in danger, how can one flee from death?" Thus he wielded sword and battle, therefore dying in the battle lines.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　世語曰：和字義權，清辯有才論。歷河南尹、太常。淵第三子稱，第五子榮。從孫湛為其序曰：「稱字叔權。自孺子而好合聚童兒，為之渠帥，戲必為軍旅戰陳之事，有違者輒嚴以鞭捶，眾莫敢逆。淵陰奇之，使讀項羽傳及兵書，不肯，曰：『能則自為耳，安能學人？』年十六，淵與之田，見奔虎，稱驅馬逐之，禁之不可，一箭而倒。名聞太祖，太祖把其手喜曰：『我得汝矣！』與文帝為布衣之交，每讌會，氣陵一坐，辯士不能屈。世之高名者多從之游。年十八卒。弟榮，字幼權。幼聰惠，七歲能屬文，誦書日千言，經目輒識之。文帝聞而請焉。賓客百餘人，人一奏刺，悉書其鄉邑名氏，世所謂爵里刺也，客示之，一寓目，使之遍談，不謬一人。帝深奇之。漢中之敗，榮年十三，左右提之走，不肯，曰：『君親在難，焉所逃死！』乃奮劍而戰，遂沒陳。」
:::
:::
:::

## Cáo Rén {.unnumbered #caoren}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"} Cáo Rén appellation Zǐxiào was Tàizǔ's younger cousin. <a href="#annotation-13" id="source-13">[13]</a> as a youth he enjoyed bow and horse and hunting, later when powerful figures were all rising, [Cáo] Rén also secretly gathered youths, obtaining over a thousand men, operating between the Huái and Sì, then followed Tàizǔ as a Separate Division Major, Acting as Fierce Vanguard Colonel. When Tàizǔ defeated Yuán Shù, those that [Cáo] Rén killed or captured were very many. Followed the campaign against Xú Province, [Cáo] Rén regularly supervised cavalry and was the army's vanguard. Separately attacked Táo Qiān's officer Lǚ Yóu, defeated him, returned and joined the main army at Péngchéng, greatly defeated [Táo] Qiān's army. Followed in attacking Fèi, Huá, Jímò, Kāiyáng,^[Fèi and Huá counties were in Tàishān in Yǎn Province; Táo Qiān had previously invaded and captured these counties. Jìmó county was in Běihǎi prefecture in Qīng Province, Kǎiyáng county was in Lángyé prefecture in Xú Province.] [Táo] Qiān sent separate officers to rescue the counties, [Cáo] Rén with cavalry struck and defeated them. When Tàizǔ campaigned against Lǚ Bù, [Cáo] Rén separately attacked Gōuyáng,^[Gōuyáng county was in Jǐyīn prefecture.] captured it, captured alive [Lǚ] Bù's officer Liú Hé. Tàizǔ pacified Huángjīn, welcomed Heaven's Son to set capital at Xǔ, [Cáo] Rén repeatedly had achievements, appointed Guǎngyáng Administrator. Tàizǔ valued his valor and strategy, did not send him to the prefecture, and had him as a Consultant Cadet supervise cavalry. When Tàizǔ campaigned against Zhāng Xiù, [Cáo] Rén separately toured through neighbouring counties, capturing males and females of over three thousand people. Tàizǔ's army returned, was pursued by [Zhāng] Xiù, the army was not successful, the soldiers dispirited, [Cáo] Rén rallied and urged the officers and servicemen with extreme exertion, Tàizǔ praised his courage, therefore they defeated [Zhāng] Xiù.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
曹仁字子孝，太祖從弟也。〔一〕少好弓馬弋獵。後豪傑並起，仁亦陰結少年，得千餘人，周旋淮、泗之間，遂從太祖為別部司馬，行厲鋒校尉。太祖之破袁術，仁所斬獲頗多。從征徐州，仁常督騎，為軍前鋒。別攻陶謙將呂由，破之，還與大軍合彭城，大破謙軍。從攻費、華、即墨、開陽，謙遣別將救諸縣，仁以騎擊破之。太祖征呂布，仁別攻句陽，拔之，生獲布將劉何。太祖平黃巾，迎天子都許，仁數有功，拜廣陽太守。太祖器其勇略，不使之郡，以議郎督騎。太祖征張繡，仁別徇旁縣，虜其男女三千餘人。太祖軍還，為繡所追，軍不利，士卒喪氣，仁率厲將士甚奮，太祖壯之，遂破繡。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-13" id="annotation-13">[13]</a> Wèi shū states: [Cáo] Rén's grandfather [Cáo] Bāo was Yǐngchuān Administrator, father [Cáo] Chì was Attendant Central and Cháng River Colonel.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：仁祖褒，潁川太守。父熾，侍中、長水校尉。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Tàizǔ and Yuán Shào were locked together for a long time at Guāndù, [Yuán] Shào sent Liú Bèi to tour through Yǐnqiáng various counties,^[Yǐnqiáng county was in Rǔnán prefecture.] many raised multitudes to support him. From Xǔ on south, the clerks and civilians were not secure, Tàizǔ believed it a concern. [Cáo] Rén said: "The south believe the main army is presently facing an immediate emergency so its strength is unable to rescue them, Liú Bèi with strong troops faces them, their betrayal is assuredly expected. [Liú] Bèi newly commands [Yuán] Shào's troops, not yet able to obtain their full use, striking him he can be defeated." Tàizǔ approved of this advice, therefore sent him to command cavalry to strike [Liú] Bèi, defeated and drove him away, [Cáo] Rén completely recovered the various rebelling counties and the returned. [Yuán] Shào sent separate officer Hán Xún to plunder and cut off the western roads, [Cáo] Rén struck [Hán] Xún at Jīluò mountain,^[Jīluò mountain was in Mì county in Hénán.] greatly defeated him. Because of this [Yuán] Shào did not dare again divide troops to send out. Again with Shǐ Huàn and others plundered [Yuán] Shào's supply carriages, burning their provisions and grain.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖與袁紹久相持於官渡，紹遣劉備徇濦彊諸縣，多舉眾應之。自許以南，吏民不安，太祖以為憂。仁曰：「南方以大軍方有目前急，其勢不能相救，劉備以彊兵臨之，其背叛固宜也。備新將紹兵，未能得其用，擊之可破也。」太祖善其言，遂使將騎擊備，破走之，仁盡復收諸叛縣而還。紹遣別將韓荀鈔斷西道，仁擊荀於雞洛山，大破之。由是紹不敢復分兵出。復與史渙等鈔紹運車，燒其糧穀。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Héběi was settled, followed in besieging Húguān. Tàizǔ's order said: "When the city is taken, massacre them all." For continuous moons it was not taken. [Cáo] Rén advised Tàizǔ stating: "In besieging cities one must show them a gate to survival, by which to open a way to live. Now Your Excellency has announced they will certainly die, so everyone will defend themselves. Moreover the city is firm and the provisions many, attacking them then the soldiers are wounded, holding them then the days will drag for a long time. Now to commit troops below a strong city, to attack caitiffs that will certainly die, is not a good plan." Tàizǔ followed this, the city surrendered. Thereupon noted [Cáo] Rén's beginning to end achievements, enfeoffed a city precinct Marquess.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
河北既定，從圍壺關。太祖令曰：「城拔，皆坑之。」連月不下。仁言於太祖曰：「圍城必示之活門，所以開其生路也。今公告之必死，將人自為守。且城固而糧多，攻之則士卒傷，守之則引日久；今頓兵堅城之下，以攻必死之虜，非良計也。」太祖從之，城降。於是錄仁前後功，封都亭侯。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Followed in pacifying Jīng Province, appointed [Cáo] Rén as Acting Campaigning South General, remaining to garrison Jiānglíng, resisting Wú officer Zhōu Yú. [Zhōu] Yú led multitudes of several tens of thousands to come attack, the vanguard of several thousand men first arrived, [Cáo] Rén ascended the city walls and looked out to them, and so recruited and obtained three hundred men, sent division retainer commander Niú Jīn to oppose them and challenge battle. The rebels were many, [Niú] Jīn's multitudes were few, therefore they were encircled. Chief Clerk Chén Jiǎo also was atop the city wall, looked out and saw [Niú] Jīn and the rest were almost lost, the Left and Right all lost color. [Cáo] Rén's spirit became extremely agitated and angry, he spoke to his Left and Right to bring his horse to come. [Chén] Jiǎo and the rest together restrained him, speaking to [Cáo] Rén stating: "The rebel multitudes are overwhelming, and cannot be faced. Even if we abandon several hundred men what is the cost to have you General personally go to them?" [Cáo] Rén did not answer, therefore donned armor and mounted horse, leading his bannermen^[The term huīxià, literally "below the signal flag," referred to an officer's personal direct command.] strong warriors of several tens of cavalry to go out the city. Away from the rebels by over a hundred bù, they approached a ditch, [Chén] Jiǎo and the rest believed [Cáo] Rén would station above the ditch to be [Niú] Jīn's support, [Cáo] Rén straightaway crossed the ditch and directly advanced, charging into the rebel encirclement, [Niú] Jīn and the rest then were able to escape. The remaining multitudes were not yet completely out, [Cáo] Rén again directly returned and charged them, extricating out [Niú] Jīn's troops, the lost were several men, the rebel multitudes then retreated. When [Chén] Jiǎo and the rest first saw [Cáo] Rén go out, all were afraid. Reaching to seeing [Cáo] Rén return, they then exclaimed stating: "General you truly are a Heavenly man!" The Three Armies respected his valor. Tàizǔ increasingly praised his courage, transferred fief to Marquess of Ānpíng precinct.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
從平荊州，以仁行征南將軍，留屯江陵，拒吳將周瑜。瑜將數萬眾來攻，前鋒數千人始至，仁登城望之，乃募得三百人，遣部曲將牛金逆與挑戰。賊多，金眾少，遂為所圍。長史陳矯俱在城上，望見金等垂沒，左右皆失色。仁意氣奮怒甚，謂左右取馬來，矯等共援持之。謂仁曰：「賊眾盛，不可當也。假使棄數百人何苦，而將軍以身赴之！」仁不應，遂被甲上馬，將其麾下壯士數十騎出城。去賊百餘步，迫溝，矯等以為仁當住溝上，為金形勢也，仁徑渡溝直前，衝入賊圍，金等乃得解。餘眾未盡出，仁復直還突之，拔出金兵，亡其數人，賊眾乃退。矯等初見仁出，皆懼，及見仁還，乃歎曰：「將軍真天人也！」三軍服其勇。太祖益壯之，轉封安平亭侯。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Tàizǔ suppressed Mǎ Chāo, appointed [Cáo] Rén as Acting Securing West General, supervising the various officers resisting at Tóng Pass, defeated [Mǎ] Chāo at Wèinán. Sū Bó, Tián Yín rebelled, appointed [Cáo] Rén as Acting Valiant Cavalry General, Overall Supervisor of seven armies to suppress [Tián] Yín and the rest, defeated them. Further appointed [Cáo] Rén as Acting Campaigning South General, Lent Stave, garrisoning Fán, defending Jīng Province. Hóu Yīn at Yuān rebelled,^[Yuān county was in Nányáng prefecture. The character is also pronounced Wǎn, but the reading Yuān is preferred here to avoid confusion with Wǎn county in Lújiāng prefecture.] plundering the neighboring counties, multitudes of several thousand men, [Cáo] Rén led the various armies to attack and defeated [Hóu] Yīn, cut off his head, returned to garrison Fán, then appointed Campaigning South General. Guān Yǔ attacked Fán, at the time the Hàn river violently overflowed, Yú Jīn and others of seven armies were all submerged, [Yú] Jīn surrendered to [Guān] Yǔ. [Cáo] Rén's men and horses of several thousand men defended the city, the city walls not submerged were a few planks. [Guān] Yǔ rode ships to approach the city walls, the encirclement several layers, outside and inside cut off, the provisions and food almost exhausted, rescue troops did not arrive. [Cáo] Rén roused and exhorted the officers and servicemen, showing they must be ready to die, the officers and servicemen were emotionally moved by him, all were without second thoughts. Xú Huǎng's rescue arrived, the water also gradually receded, [Xú] Huǎng from the outside struck [Guān] Yǔ, [Cáo] Rén was about to burst out the encirclement, [Guān] Yǔ retreated and fled.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖討馬超，以仁行安西將軍，督諸將拒潼關，破超渭南。蘇伯、田銀反，以仁行驍騎將軍，都督七軍討銀等，破之。復以仁行征南將軍，假節，屯樊，鎮荊州。侯音以宛叛，略傍縣眾數千人，仁率諸軍攻破音，斬其首，還屯樊，即拜征南將軍。關羽攻樊，時漢水暴溢，于禁等七軍皆沒，禁降羽。仁人馬數千人守城，城不沒者數板。羽乘船臨城，圍數重，外內斷絕，糧食欲盡，救兵不至。仁激厲將士，示以必死，將士感之皆無二。徐晃救至，水亦稍減，晃從外擊羽，仁得潰圍出，羽退走。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When [Cáo] Rén was young he did not cultivate conduct and restriant, when grown he became an officer, he was strict and orderly in observing laws and orders, always keeping regulations to his left and right, consulting them in conducting affairs. When the Marquess of Yānlíng^[Yānlíng county was in Yǐngchuān prefecture.] [Cáo] Zhāng campaigned north against the Wūhuán, Emperor Wén was at the East Palace, wrote a letter warning [Cáo] Zhāng that said: "In being an offcer and observing law, should one not be like the Campaigning South?" Reaching to ascending the King's throne, appointed [Cáo] Rén as Chariots and Cavalry General, Overall Supervisor of Jīng, Yáng, and Yì Provinces various military affairs, advanced in fief to Marquess of Chén,^[Chén county was in Chén state.] increased estate by two thousand, adding to the previous to three thousand five hundred households. Posthumously bestowed on [Cáo] Rén's father [Cáo] Chì posthumous name as Marquess Mù of Chén, installed burial mound maintainers of ten families. Later summoned back to garrison Yuān. Sūn Quán sent his officer Chén Shào to occupy Xiāngyáng, Edict on [Cáo] Rén to suppress him. [Cáo] Rén with Xú Huǎng attacked and defeated [Chén] Shào, therefore entered Xiāngyáng, sent General Gāo Qiān and others to relocate the civilians south of the Hàn attaching and acculturing to the Hàn's north. Emperor Wén sent envoy to then appoint [Cáo] Rén as General-in-Chief. Also Edict on [Cáo] Rén to move garrison to Línyǐng,^[Línyǐng county was in Yǐngchuān prefecture.] promoted to Marshal-in-Chief, further supervising the various armies occupying Wūjiāng, returned to garrison Héféi. Huángchū Fourth Year [223] died, posthumous name Zhōng-hóu. <a href="#annotation-14" id="source-14">[14]</a> His son [Cáo] Tài succeeded, office reached Defending East General, Lent Stave, transferred fief to Marquess of Nínglíng.^[Nínglíng county was in Liáng prefecture.] [Cáo] Tài died, his son [Cáo] Chū succeeded. Also divided to enfeoff [Cáo] Tài's younger brothers [Cáo] Kǎi and [Cáo] Fàn all as Ranked Marquesses, while Niú Jīn's office reached Rear General.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
仁少時不脩行檢，及長為將，嚴整奉法令，常置科於左右，案以從事。鄢陵侯彰北征烏丸，文帝在東宮，為書戒彰曰：「為將奉法，不當如征南邪！」及即王位，拜仁車騎將軍，都督荊、揚、益州諸軍事，進封陳侯，增邑二千，并前三千五百戶。追賜仁父熾諡曰陳穆侯，置守冢十家。後召還屯宛。孫權遣將陳邵據襄陽，詔仁討之。仁與徐晃攻破邵，遂入襄陽，使將軍高遷等徙漢南附化民於漢北，文帝遣使即拜仁大將軍。又詔仁移屯臨潁，遷大司馬，復督諸軍據烏江，還屯合肥。黃初四年薨，諡曰忠侯。〔一〕子泰嗣，官至鎮東將軍，假節，轉封甯陵侯。泰薨，子初嗣。又分封泰弟楷、範，皆為列侯，而牛金官至後將軍。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-14" id="annotation-14">[14]</a> Wèi shū states: [Cáo] Rén at the time was aged fifty-six.

Fù-zǐ states: Marshal-in-Chief Cáo's valor, [Mèng] Bēn and [Xià] Yù could not surpass.^[Mèng Bēn and Xià Yù were legendary warriors from the Warring States era.] Zhāng Liáo was next after him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：仁時年五十六。傅子曰：曹大司馬之勇，賁、育弗加也。張遼其次焉。
:::
:::
:::

### Cáo Chún {.unnumbered #caochun}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"} [Cáo] Rén's younger brother [Cáo] Chún <a href="#annotation-15" id="source-15">[15]</a> first as a Consultant Cadet was Advisor to Excellency of Works Military Affairs, supervised the Tiger Leopard Cavalry and followed in the siege of Nánpí. Yuán Tán went out to battle, of the soldiers many died. Tàizǔ wished to ease off him, [Cáo] Chún said: "Now having tread a thousand lǐ against the enemy, if advancing we cannot succeed, retreating is certain to damage prestige. Moreover a hanging brigade peeply penetrated is difficult to hold for long. They are victorious and become arrogant, we are beaten and become fearful, using the fearful to match the arrogant, we can certainly succeed." Tàizǔ approved of this advice, therefore urgently attacked them, [Yuán] Tán was defeated. [Cáo] Chún's bannermen cavalry cut off [Yuán] Tán's head. Reaching to the northern campaign against the three prefectures, [Cáo] Chún's division cavalry captured the Chányú Tàdùn. For the beginning to end achievements enfeoffed Marquess of Gāolíng precinct, estate three hundred households. Followed the campaign against Jīng Province, pursued Liú Bèi at Chángbăn, captured his two daughters and heavy supplies, collected his scattered soldiers. Advanced to subdue Jiānglíng, followed the return to Qiáo. Jiàn'ān Fifteenth Year [210] died. Emperor Wén succeeded the throne, gave posthumous name called Wēi-hóu. <a href="#annotation-16" id="source-16">[16]</a> His son [Cáo] Yǎn succeeded, office reached Manager of the Army General, during Zhèngyuán [254 - 255] advanced fief to Marquess of Pínglè village. [Cáo] Yǎn died, his son [Cáo] Liàng succeeded.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
仁弟純，〔一〕初以議郎參司空軍事，督虎豹騎從圍南皮。袁譚出戰，士卒多死。太祖欲緩之，純曰：「今千里蹈敵，進不能克，退必喪威；且縣師深入，難以持久。彼勝而驕，我敗而懼，以懼敵驕，必可克也。」太祖善其言，遂急攻之，譚敗。純麾下騎斬譚首。及北征三郡，純部騎獲單于蹋頓。以前後功封高陵亭侯，邑三百戶。從征荊州，追劉備於長阪，獲其二女輜重，收其散卒。進降江陵，從還譙。建安十五年薨。文帝即位，追諡曰威侯。〔二〕子演嗣，官至領軍將軍，正元中進封平樂鄉侯。演薨，子亮嗣。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-15" id="annotation-15">[15]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: [Cáo] Chún appellation Zǐhé. Aged fourteen he was in mourning for his father, with his elder brother of the same mother [Cáo] Rén separately living. Inherited his father's enterprise, wealthy in property, the servants and retainers were in the hundreds, [Cáo] Chún managed and supervised, not losing organization, his hometown all believed him capable. He enjoyed learning and inquiry, respected and favored scholars, of scholars many joined him, because of this he was praised far and near. Aged eighteen, he became a Yellow Gate Attendant Cadet. At twenty, followed Tàizǔ to arrive at Xiāngyì to recruit troops, therefore always followed in campaigns and battles.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　英雄記曰：純字子和。年十四而喪父，與同產兄仁別居。承父業，富於財，僮僕人客以百數，純綱紀督御，不失其理，鄉里咸以為能。好學問，敬愛學士，學士多歸焉，由是為遠近所稱。年十八，為黃門侍郎。二十，從太祖到襄邑募兵，遂常從征戰。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-16" id="annotation-16">[16]</a> Wèi shū states: The Tiger Leopard Cavalry that [Cáo] Chún commanded were all the valiant and keen of Heaven's Under, some openings were filled by commanders of a hundred men, Tàizǔ found it difficult to find a commander. [Cáo] Chún was selected as the supervisor, succorred and cared and extremely obtained the people's hearts. When he died, relevant managers reported to select a replacement. Tàizǔ said: "One comparable to [Cáo] Chún, how could it again be found? Am I alone not capable of supervising?" Therefore did not select.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：純所督虎豹騎，皆天下驍銳，或從百人將補之，太祖難其帥。純以選為督，撫循甚得人心。及卒，有司白選代，太祖曰：「純之比，何可復得！吾獨不中督邪？」遂不選。
:::
:::
:::

## Cáo Hóng {.unnumbered #caohong}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Cáo Hóng appellation Zǐlián was Tàizǔ's younger cousin. <a href="#annotation-17" id="source-17">[17]</a> Tàizǔ raised Righteous Troops to suppress Dǒng Zhuó, reached Xíngyáng, was by [Dǒng] Zhuó's officer Xú Róng defeated. Tàizǔ lost his horse, the rebels pursued extremely urgently, [Cáo] Hóng dismounted and gave his horse to Tàizǔ. Tàizǔ declined, [Cáo] Hóng said: "Heaven's Under can be without [Cáo] Hóng, it cannot be without you." Therefore on foot he followed and arrived at the Biàn river, the river was deep and could not be crossed, [Cáo] Hóng along the river found a boat, with Tàizǔ together crossed, returned and fled to Qiáo. Yáng Province Inspector Chén Wēn formerly with [Cáo] Hóng was friendly, [Cáo] Hóng led family troops of over a thousand men, joined [Chén] Wēn to recruit troops, obtained Lújiāng elite armored of two thousand men, went east to arrive at Dānyáng and further obtained several thousand men, with Tàizǔ meeting at Lóngkàng.^[Lóngkàng county was in Pèi prefecture.] When Tàizǔ campaigned against Xú Province, Zhāng Miǎo raised Yǎn Province in rebellion to welcome Lǚ Bù. At the time there was great famine, [Cáo] Hóng led troops at the front, first occupied Dōngpíng and Fàn, gathered provisions and grain to sustain the army. Tàizǔ suppressed [Zhāng] Miǎo and [Lǚ] Bù at Púyáng, [Lǚ] Bù was defeated and fled, therefore occupied Dōng'ē, turned  to strike Jǐyīn, Shānyáng, Zhōngmù, Yángwǔ, Jīng, Mì over ten counties, all captured them.^[Dōng'ē was in Dōng prefecture. Jǐyīn and Shānyáng were prefectures, and in this context refer to the counties containing the prefectural capitals. Zhōngmù, Yángwǔ, Jīng, Mì counties were in Hénán prefecture.] For beginning to end achievements appointed Falcon Rising Colonel, promoted to Raising Warfare Central Cadet General. When Heaven's Son set capital at Xǔ, appointed [Cáo] Hóng as Remonstration Consultant Gradee. Separately campaigned against Liú Biǎo, defeated [Liú] Biǎo's separate officer at Wǔyáng, Yīn, Shè, Dǔyáng, Bówàng,^[Wǔyáng was in Yǐngchuān, Yīn, Shè, Dǔyáng, Bówàng were in Nányáng. The name of Shè county is sometimes also given as Yè, as in modern times the pronunciation Yè is more common for the character.] had achievements, promoted to Fierce Vanguard General, enfeoffed Marquess of Guómíng precinct. Repeatedly followed on campaign, appointed Overall Protector General. When Emperor Wén succeeded the throne, became Guard General, promoted to Agile Cavalry General, advanced fief to Marquess of Yěwáng,^[Yěwáng county was in Hénèi prefecture.] increased estate by one thousand households, adding with the previous to two thousand one hundred households, position Specially Advanced. Later moved fief to Marquess of Dūyáng.^[Dūyáng county was in Dōnghǎi prefecture.]
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
曹洪字子廉，太祖從弟也。〔一〕太祖起義兵討董卓，至滎陽，為卓將徐榮所敗。太祖失馬，賊追甚急，洪下，以馬授太祖，太祖辭讓，洪曰：「天下可無洪，不可無君。」遂步從到汴水，水深不得渡，洪循水得船，與太祖俱濟，還奔譙。揚州刺史陳溫素與洪善，洪將家兵千餘人，就溫募兵，得廬江上甲二千人，東到丹楊復得數千人，與太祖會龍亢。太祖征徐州，張邈舉兗州叛迎呂布。時大饑荒，洪將兵在前，先據東平、范，聚糧穀以繼軍。太祖討邈、布於濮陽，布破走，遂據東阿，轉擊濟陰、山陽、中牟、陽武、京、密十餘縣，皆拔之。以前後功拜鷹揚校尉，遷揚武中郎將。天子都許，拜洪諫議大夫。別征劉表，破表別將於舞陽、陰葉、堵陽、博望，有功，遷厲鋒將軍，封國明亭侯。累從征伐，拜都護將軍。文帝即位，為衛將軍，遷驃騎將軍，進封野王侯，益邑千戶，并前二千一百戶，位特進；後徙封都陽侯。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-17" id="annotation-17">[17]</a> Wèi shū states: [Cáo] Hóng's father's elder brother [Cáo] Dǐng was Secretariat Writers Director, appointed [Cáo] Hóng as Qíchūn Chief.^[Qíchūn county was in Jiāngxià prefecture.]
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：洪伯父鼎為尚書令，任洪為蘄春長。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, [Cáo] Hóng's family was wealthy but by nature he was miserly, when Emperor Wén was young his request to borrow something was not fulfilled, always resented this, and therefore used his household retainers violating law to send him down to prison to die. the various ministers all pleaded but none were able to obtain it. Dowager Empress Biàn spoke to Empress Guō stating: "Now if Cáo Hóng dies today, tomorrow I will order the Emperor to depose the Empress." Thereupon she wept tears and repeatedly pleaded, and so obtained a dismissal from office and removal of noble title and territory. <a href="#annotation-18" id="source-18">[18]</a> [Cáo] Hóng was an accomplished minister of the Former Emperor, at the time of the people many were dissatisfied and disappointed. When Emperor Míng succeeded the throne, appointed Rear General, again enfeoffed as Marquess of Yuèchéng, estate a thousand households, position Specially Advanced, again appointed Agile Cavalry General. Tàihé Sixth Year [232] died, posthumous name Gōng-hóu. His son [Cáo] Fù succeeded the Marquessate. Previously, Tàizǔ divided [Cáo] Hóng's households to enfeoff his son [Cáo] Zhèn as a Ranked Marquess. [Cáo] Hóng's cousin's father [Cáo] Yú cultivated cautiou and was sincerely respectful, office reached Guard General, enfeoffed a Ranked Marquess.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
始，洪家富而性吝嗇，文帝少時假求不稱，常恨之，遂以舍客犯法，下獄當死。群臣並救莫能得。卞太后謂郭后曰：「令曹洪今日死，吾明日敕帝廢后矣。」於是泣涕屢請，乃得免官削爵土。〔一〕洪先帝功臣，時人多為觖望。明帝即位，拜後將軍，更封樂城侯，邑千戶，位特進，復拜驃騎將軍。太和六年薨，諡曰恭侯。子馥，嗣侯。初，太祖分洪戶封子震列侯。洪族父瑜，脩慎篤敬，官至衛將軍，封列侯。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-18" id="annotation-18">[18]</a> Wèilüè states: When Emperor Wén arrested [Cáo] Hóng, at the time Cáo Zhēn was among the Left and Right and pleaded for him stating: "Now if you execute [Cáo] Hóng, [Cáo] Hóng certainly will believe it was by [me, Cáo] Zhēn slandering him." The Emperor said: "I am personally managing it, why are you involving yourself?" It happened that Dowager Empress Biàn angrily rebuked the Emperor saying: "Between Liáng and Pèi, if not for Zǐlián there would be no today." Edict thus released him, but still confiscated his property. The Dowager Empress again spoke about this, later thus returned it. Previously, at the time when Tàizǔ was Excellency of Works, to be a personal example to the subordinates, every year in assessing taxes, he had his home county judge assets. At the time the Qiáo Magistrate judged [Cáo] Hóng's assets as the same grade as his Excellency's family, Tàizǔ said: "How can my family assets be able to compare to Zǐlián's?" When Emperor Wén was at the East Palace, he once borrowed fabric of a hundrd pǐ from [Cáo] Hóng, [Cáo] Hóng did not fulfill his wishes. Reaching to [Cáo] Hóng violating law, he himself considered he would certainly die. When he was pardoned, he was joyous, and sent up letter of apology that said: "your Servant in youth did not follow the way, transgressed in human relationships, ever stole improper appointments, then immersed in tolerance and forgiveness. By nature I am without restraint and sense of knowing contentment, but instead have the character of unsatisfiable as a jackal and wolf, in old age my confusion and greed multipled, collided with the state's net, my crimes approach three thousand, not worthy of pardon and forgiveness, and should meet with punishment and execution, abandoned in various markets. Yet immersed in Heaven's grace, my bone and flesh live again. Your Servant looks up to Heaven's sun, ashamed of my betrayal of the sprits, look down to ponder transgressions and deficiencies, ashamed and shuddering in fear, unable to like a pheasant hang to kill himself, I solemnly muddy face at the gates, bowing with Reply to explain my feelings."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏略曰：文帝收洪，時曹真在左右，請之曰：「今誅洪，洪必以真為譖也。」帝曰：「我自治之，卿何豫也？」會卞太后責怒帝，言「梁、沛之間，非子廉無有今日」。詔乃釋之。猶尚沒入其財產。太后又以為言，後乃還之。初，太祖為司空時，以己率下，每歲發調，使本縣平貲。于時譙令平洪貲財與公家等，太祖曰：「我家貲那得如子廉耶！」文帝在東宮，嘗從洪貸絹百匹，洪不稱意。及洪犯法，自分必死，既得原，喜，上書謝曰：「臣少不由道，過在人倫，長竊非任，遂蒙含貸。性無檢度知足之分，而有豺狼無厭之質，老惛倍貪，觸突國網，罪迫三千，不在赦宥，當就辜誅，棄諸市朝，猶蒙天恩，骨肉更生。臣仰視天日，愧負靈神，俯惟愆闕，慚愧怖悸，不能雉經以自裁割，謹塗顏闕門，拜章陳情。」
:::
:::
:::

## Cáo Xiū {.unnumbered #caoxiu}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Cáo Xiū appellation Wénliè was Tàizǔ's cousin's son. Heaven's Under was in chaos, the clansmen each scattered and left the hometown. [Cáo] Xiū was aged over ten years, lost his father, and alone with one retainer carried the body for temporary burial, taking along his elderly mother, crossed the Jiāng to reach Wú. <a href="#annotation-19" id="source-19">[19]</a> As Tàizǔ was raising Righteous Troops, he changed his family name and personal name, turned to reach Jīng Province, secretly went to return north, meeting Tàizǔ. Tàizǔ spoke to his Left and Right stating: "This is my family's thousand lǐ colt." Sent him to stay together with Emperor Wén, he met with treatment like to a son. He regularly followed on campaign, sent to manage the Tiger and Leopard Cavalry and Residential Guard. Liú Bèi sent his officer Wú Lán to garrison Xiàbiàn,^[Xiàbiàn county was in Wǔdū prefecture.] Tàizǔ sent Cáo Hóng to campaign against him, with [Cáo] Xiū as a Cavalry Commandant, Advisor to [Cáo] Hóng's military affairs. Tàizǔ spoke to [Cáo] Xiū stating: "Although you are an Advisor to the Army, in fact you are the commander." [Cáo] Hóng heard this Order and also entrusted affairs to [Cáo] Xiū. [Liú] Bèi sent Zhāng Fēi to garrison Gùshān,^[Gùshān or Gù mountain was probably in or near Dīdào county in Wǔdū prefecture.] wishing to cut off the army's rear. The mass of commentators were hesitant, [Cáo] Xiū said: "If the rebels truly were cutting off the road, they would with hidden troops travel in stealth. Now then to first spread a sound of force, this then is that they are unable. We should when they are not yet gathered hurry to strike [Wú] Lán, if [Wú] Lán is defeated then [Zhāng] Fēi will flee on his own." [Cáo] Hóng followed this, advanced troops to strike [Wú] Lán, greatly defeated him, [Zhāng] Fēi indeed fled. Tàizǔ evacuated Hànzhōng, the various armies returned to Cháng'ān, appointed [Cáo] Xiū as Central Manager of the Army. When Emperor Wén succeeded the King's throne, became Manager of the Army General, noted beginning to end achievements, enfeoffed Marquess of Dōngyáng precinct. When Xiàhóu Dūn died, appointed [Cáo] Xiū as Defending South General, Lent Stave as Overall Supervisor of various military affairs, the Chariot Carriage saw him off, the Superior then dismounted carriage and grasped his hand to part with him.^[Chariot Carriage (chējià) refers to the Emperor's chariot and by extension to the Emperor himself. Superior (shàng) is a third person term for the Emperor. The timing of this event is slightly uncertain as there were a few months between the death of Xiàhóu Dūn and the actual ascension of Cáo Pī as Emperor, so there is a possibility that these Imperial terms are being used anachronstically.] Sūn Quán sent his officers to garrison Lìyáng,^[Lìyáng county was in Jiǔjiāng/Huáinán prefecture.] [Cáo] Xiū arrived, struck and defeated them, also separately sent troops to cross the Jiāng, burned the rebel Wúhú camps of several thousand families.^[Wúhú county was in Dānyáng prefecture.] Promoted to Campaigning East General, designate Yáng Province Inspector, advanced in fief to Marquess of Ānyáng village. <a href="#annotation-20" id="source-20">[20]</a> When the Emperor campaigned against Sūn Quán, appointed [Cáo] Xiū as Campaigning East General-in-Chief, Lent Yellow Battle-Ax, supervising Zhāng Liáo and others with the various provinces and prefectures  of over twenty armies, struck [Sūn] Quán's chief officer Lǚ Fàn and others at Dòngpǔ,^[Dòngpǔ was in Lìyáng county.] defeated him. Appointed Yáng Province Governor. When Emperor Míng succeeded the throne, advanced fief to Marquess of Chángpíng.^[Chángpíng county was in Chén state.] Wú officer Shěn Dé garrisoned Wăn,^[Wǎn county was in Lújiāng prefecture.] [Cáo] Xiū struck and defeated him, cut off [Shěn] Dé's head, Wú officers Hán Zōng and Zhái Dān and others beginning to end led their multitudes to go to [Cáo] Xiū to surrender. Increased estate by four hundred, adding with the previous to two thousand five hundred households, promoted to Marshal-in-Chief, Overall Supervisor of Yáng Province as before. Tàihé Second Year [228], the Emperor on two routes campaigned against Wú, sent Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng from the Hàn river downstrea, [Cáo] Xiū supervising the various armies heading toward Xúnyáng.^[Xúnyáng county was in Lújiāng prefecture.] A rebel officer falsely surrendered, [Cáo] Xiū deeply penetrated, battled and was not successful, retreated and returned to lodge at Shí precinct. The army in the night was alarmed, the soldiers in chaos, the abandoned armor and weapons and heavy supplies was extremely many. [Cáo] Xiū sent up letter apologizing for his crimes, the Emperor sent Garrison Cavalry Colonel Yáng Jì to comfort and reassure him, the gifts and bestowals increasingly expansive. [Cáo] Xiū because of this had ulcers develop on his back and he died, posthumous name called Zhuàng-hóu. His son [Cáo] Zhào succeeded. <a href="#annotation-21" id="source-21">[21]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
曹休字文烈，太祖族子也。天下亂，宗族各散去鄉里。休年十餘歲，喪父，獨與一客擔喪假葬，攜將老母，渡江至吳。〔一〕以太祖舉義兵，易姓名轉至荊州，閒行北歸，見太祖。太祖謂左右曰：「此吾家千里駒也。」使與文帝同止，見待如子。常從征伐，使領虎豹騎宿衛。劉備遣將吳蘭屯下辯，太祖遣曹洪征之，以休為騎都尉，參洪軍事。太祖謂休曰：「汝雖參軍，其實帥也。」洪聞此令，亦委事於休。備遣張飛屯固山，欲斷軍後。眾議狐疑，休曰：「賊實斷道者，當伏兵潛行。今乃先張聲勢，此其不能也。宜及其未集，促擊蘭，蘭破則飛自走矣。」洪從之，進兵擊蘭，大破之，飛果走。太祖拔漢中，諸軍還長安，拜休中領軍。文帝即王位，為領軍將軍，錄前後功，封東陽亭侯。夏侯惇薨，以休為鎮南將軍，假節都督諸軍事，車駕臨送，上乃下輿執手而別。孫權遣將屯歷陽，休到，擊破之，又別遣兵渡江，燒賊蕪湖營數千家。遷征東將軍，領揚州刺史，進封安陽鄉侯。〔二〕帝征孫權，以休為征東大將軍，假黃鉞，督張遼等及諸州郡二十餘軍，擊權大將呂範等於洞浦，破之。拜揚州牧。明帝即位，進封長平侯。吳將審德屯皖，休擊破之，斬德首，吳將韓綜、翟丹等前後率眾詣休降。增邑四百，并前二千五百戶，遷大司馬，都督揚州如故。太和二年，帝為二道征吳，遣司馬宣王從漢水下，（督休）〔休督〕諸軍向尋陽。賊將偽降，休深入，戰不利，退還宿石亭。軍夜驚，士卒亂，棄甲兵輜重甚多。休上書謝罪，帝遣屯騎校尉楊暨慰諭，禮賜益隆。休因此癰發背薨，諡曰壯侯。子肇嗣。〔三〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-19" id="annotation-19">[19]</a> Wèi shū states: [Cáo] Xiū's grandfather had once been Wú prefecture Administrator. [Cáo] Xiū at the Administrator's residence saw his grandfather's portrait on a wall, dismounted his seat and bowed shedding tears, those seated with him all praised and sighed for him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：休祖父嘗為吳郡太守。休於太守舍，見壁上祖父畫像，下榻拜涕泣，同坐者皆嘉歎焉。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-20" id="annotation-20">[20]</a> Wèi shū states: [Cáo] Xiū mourned for his mother with utmost filial piety. The emperor sent an Attendant Central to seize away his mourning clothes and force him to drink liquor and eat meat, [Cáo] Xiū accepted the Edict but his body became increasingly thin and withered. He begged to return to Qiáo to bury his mother, the Emperor again sent Surpassing Cavalry Colonel Xuē Qiáo to present Edict on him to limit his sorrow and grief, allow him to return home to perform mourning, stay for one night and then bury, and when the burial finished to go visit where [the Emperor] was travelling.^[Where (the Emperor) was traveling (xíng zài suǒ) was a term for where the Emperor happened to be, often used for when the Emperor was not at the Palace.] The Emperor saw him, personally comforted and consoled him. He met with affection and value like this.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：休喪母至孝。帝使侍中奪喪服，使飲酒食肉，休受詔而形體益憔悴。乞歸譙葬母，帝復遣越騎校尉薛喬奉詔節其憂哀，使歸家治喪，一宿便葬，葬訖詣行在所。帝見，親自寬慰之。其見愛重如此。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-21" id="annotation-21">[21]</a> Shìyǔ states: [Cáo] Zhào appellation Chángsī.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　世語曰：肇字長思。
:::
:::
:::

### Cáo Zhào {.unnumbered #caozhao}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Cáo] Zhào had talent and competence in his era, became Cavalier Regular Attendant, Garrison Cavalry Colonel. When Emperor Míng was lying ill, he was about to have him and King of Yān [Cáo] Yǔ and others entrusted with later affairs. The Emperor's intentions soon changed, Edict on [Cáo] Zhào to as a Marquess return to his mansion. During Zhèngshǐ [240 - 249] he died. Posthumously titled Guard General. His son [Cáo] Xīng succeeded. Previously, Emperor Wén divided from [Cáo] Xiū three hundred households to enfeoff [Cáo] Zhào's younger brother [Cáo] Zuǎn as a Ranked Marquess, later became Exterminating Wú General, died, posthumously titled Front General. <a href="#annotation-22" id="source-22">[22]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
肇有當世才度，為散騎常侍、屯騎校尉。明帝寢疾，方與燕王宇等屬以後事。帝意尋變，詔肇以侯歸第。正始中薨。追贈衛將軍。子興嗣。初，文帝分休戶三百封肇弟纂為列侯，後為殄吳將軍，薨，追贈前將軍。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-22" id="annotation-22">[22]</a> Zhāng Yǐn's Wénshì Zhuàn states: [Cáo] Zhào's grandson [Cáo] Shū appellation Yányuǎn, in youth sharpened his will and conduct, widely learned and had talent and literary elegance, served Jìn, recruited to the Offices of the Excellencies, successively Luòyáng Magistrate, having reputation for ability. Marshal-in-Chief the King of Qí [Sīmǎ] Jiǒng assisted in government, [Cáo] Shū with Qí man Zuǒ Sī together were his Records Office Supervisors. From Central Cadet he was sent out to be Xiāngyáng Administrator, Campaigning South Major. It happened that Heaven's Under was in chaos, [Cáo] Shū suppressed rebels and headed towards Wú, defeated in battle and died.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　張隱文士傳曰：肇孫攄，字顏遠，少厲志操，博學有才藻。仕晉，辟公府，歷洛陽令，有能名。大司馬齊王冏輔政，攄與齊人左思俱為記室督。從中郎出為襄陽太守、征南司馬。值天下亂，攄討賊向吳，戰敗死。
:::
:::
:::

## Cáo Zhēn {.unnumbered #caozhen}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Cáo Zhēn appellation Zǐdān was Tàizǔ's cousin's son. When Tàizǔ raised troops, [Cáo] Zhēn's father [Cáo] Shào recruited follower multitudes, and was killed by the provinces and prefecuteres. <a href="#annotation-23" id="source-23">[23]</a> Tàizǔ pitied that [Cáo] Zhēn was young to be fatherless, adopted and raised him together with the various sons, having him reside together with Emperor Wén. Once while hunting he was chased by a tiger, he looked back and shot the tiger, at the sound (of the shot) it fell. Tàizǔ praised his fierce valor, having him command the Tiger Leopard Cavalry. Suppressed Língqiū rebels,^[Língqiū county was in Dài prefecture.] captured it, enfeoffed Marquess of Língshòu precinct. As Auxiliary General he commanded troops to strike Liú Bèi's separate officers at Xiàbiàn, defeated them, appointed Central Rampart General. Followed reaching to Cháng'ān, designate Central Manager of the Army. At the time, Xiàhóu Yuān was lost at Yángpíng, Tàizǔ worried about this, appointed [Cáo] Zhēn as Campaigning against Shǔ Protector of the Army, supervising Xú Huǎng and others to defeat Liú Bèi's separate officer Gāo Xiáng at Yángpíng. Tàizǔ personally reached Hànzhōng, evacuated out the various armies, sent [Cáo] Zhēn to reach Wǔdū to welcome Cáo Hóng and the rest to return to garrison Chéncāng. When Emperor Wén succeeded the King's throne, appointed [Cáo] Zhēn as Defending West General, Lent Stave as Overall Supervisor of Yōng and Liáng Provinces' various military affairs. Noted his beginning to end achievements, advanced in fief to Marquess of Dōng village. Zhāng Jìn and others rebelled at Jiǔquán, [Cáo] Zhēn sent Fèi Yào to suppress and defeated them, beheaded [Zhāng] Jìn and the rest. Huángchū Third Year [222], returned to the capital city, appointed [Cáo] Zhēn as Upper Army General-in-Chief, Overall Supervisor of Central and External various military affairs, Lent Stave and Battle-Ax. With Xiàhóu Shàng and others campaigned against Sūn Quán, struck the Niúzhū garrison,^[Niúzhū was in Dānyáng county.] defeated it. Transferred appointment to Central Army General-in-Chief, added Dispensing Affairs Central. Seventh Year [226], Emperor Wen was lying ill, [Cáo] Zhēn with Chén Qún, Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng and otehrs received the Legacy Edict to assist in government. When Emperor Míng succeeded the throne, advanced fief to Marquess of Shàolíng,^[Shàolíng county was in Rǔnán prefecture.] <a href="#annotation-24" id="source-24">[24]</a> promoted to General-in-Chief.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
曹真字子丹，太祖族子也。太祖起兵，真父邵募徒眾，為州郡所殺。〔一〕太祖哀真少孤，收養與諸子同，使與文帝共止。常獵，為虎所逐，顧射虎，應聲而倒。太祖壯其鷙勇，使將虎豹騎。討靈丘賊，拔之，封靈壽亭侯。以偏將軍將兵擊劉備別將於下辯，破之，拜中堅將軍。從至長安，領中領軍。是時，夏侯淵沒於陽平，太祖憂之。以真為征蜀護軍，督徐晃等破劉備別將高詳於陽平。太祖自至漢中，拔出諸軍，使真至武都迎曹洪等還屯陳倉。文帝即王位，以真為鎮西將軍，假節都督雍、涼州諸軍事。錄前後功，進封東鄉侯。張進等反於酒泉，真遣費曜討破之，斬進等。黃初三年還京都，以真為上軍大將軍，都督中外諸軍事，假節鉞。與夏侯尚等征孫權，擊牛渚屯，破之。轉拜中軍大將軍，加給事中。七年，文帝寢疾，真與陳群、司馬宣王等受遺詔輔政。明帝即位，進封邵陵侯，〔二〕遷大將軍。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-23" id="annotation-23">[23]</a> Wèilüè states: [Cáo] Zhēn was originally surnamed Qín, adopted into the Cáo clan. Some say his father [Qín] Bónán had from early on been friends with Tàizǔ. At the end of Xīngpíng [194 - 195], Yuán Shù's division faction with Tàizǔ attacked and plundered, Tàizǔ went out, was pursued by bandits, fled to the Qín clan. Bónán opened the gates to receive him. The bandits asked where Tàizǔ was, he answered saying: "I am he." Therefore murdered him. Because of this Tàizǔ remembered his achievements, and therefore changed his surname.

Wèishū states: [Cáo] Shào for loyal sincerity and having talent and strategy was closely trusted by Tàizǔ. During Chūpíng [190 - 193], Tàizǔ raised Righteous Troops, [Cáo] Shào recruited follower multitudes, following Tàizǔ all around. At the time Yù Province Inspector Huáng Wǎn wished to harm Tàizǔ, Tàizǔ escaped this but [Cáo] Shào alone encountered harm.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏略曰：真本姓秦，養曹氏。或云其父伯南夙與太祖善。興平末，袁術部黨與太祖攻劫，太祖出，為寇所追，走入秦氏，伯南開門受之。寇問太祖所在，答云：「我是也。」遂害之。由此太祖思其功，故變其姓。魏書曰：邵以忠篤有才智，為太祖所親信。初平中，太祖興義兵，邵募徒眾，從太祖周旋。時豫州刺史黃琬欲害太祖，太祖避之而邵獨遇害。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-24" id="annotation-24">[24]</a> Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: [Cáo] Zhēn's father was named Shào.
