Fief as Marquess of Shàolíng, if it is not an error in the book, then the matter cannot be explained.^[The personal name of an individual's father would usually be a name taboo for the individual in most situations. It would be very awkward for someone to be given a fief sharing a character with their father's personal name.]
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　臣松之案：真父名邵。封邵陵侯，若非書誤，則事不可論。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Zhūgě Liàng besieged Qíshān, Nán'ān, Tiānshuǐ, Āndìng three prefectures rebelled in support of [Zhūgě] Liàng. The Emperor sent [Cáo] Zhēn to supervise the various armies to station Méi,^[Méi county was in Yòufúfēng.] sent Zhāng Hé to strike [Zhūgě] Liàng's officer Mǎ Sù, greatly defeated him. Āndìng civilian Yáng Tiáo and others captured the clerks and civilians to protect Yuèzhī city, [Cáo] Zhēn advanced hte army to besiege them. [Yáng] Tiáo spoke to his multitudes stating: "The General-in-Chief has personally come, I can only hope to quickly surrender." Therefore he bound himself and went out. The three prefectures were all pacified. [Cáo] Zhēn believed as [Zhūgě] Liàng had been chastened at Qíshān, in setting out later he certainly would come from Chéncāng, and so sent Generals Hǎo Zhāo and Wáng Shēng to defend Chéncāng, repairing its city walls. The next year Spring, [Zhūgě] Liàng indeed besieged Chéncāng, it already had preparations and could not be conquered. Increased estate, adding with the previous to two thousand nine hundred households. Fourth Year [230], attended Court at Luòyáng, promoted to Marshal-in-Chief, bestowed honor to with sword and shoes ascend halls, enter Court without hastening. [Cáo] Zhēn believed: "Shǔ continuously sets out to invade the borders, it is appropriate then to attack them. On multiple routes all entering, we can greatly succeed." The Emperor followed this plan. [Cáo] Zhēn was about to mobilize the western suppression, the Emperor personally saw him off. [Cáo] Zhēn in the Eighth Moon [230 Aug 27 - Sep 24] left Cháng'ān, from the Zǐwǔ route entering south. Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng went up the Hàn river, to meet at Nánzhèng. Of the various armies some followed the Yé valley route,^[The character for Yé is also pronounced Xié, which is favored in modern times, though Yé is believed closer to the ancient pronunciation.] some from Wǔwēi entered. It happened it greatly continuously rained for over thirty days, some plank roads were cut off, Edict on [Cáo] Zhēn to withdraw the armies.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
諸葛亮圍祁山，南安、天水、安定三郡反應亮。帝遣真督諸軍軍郿，遣張郃擊亮將馬謖，大破之。安定民楊條等略吏民保月支城，真進軍圍之。條謂其眾曰：「大將軍自來，吾願早降耳。」遂自縛出。三郡皆平。真以亮懲於祁山，後出必從陳倉，乃使將軍郝昭、王生守陳倉，治其城。明年春，亮果圍陳倉，已有備而不能克。增邑，并前二千九百戶。四年，朝洛陽，遷大司馬，賜劍履上殿，入朝不趨。真以「蜀連出侵邊境，宜遂伐之。數道並入，可大克也」。帝從其計。真當發西討，帝親臨送。真以八月發長安，從子午道南入。司馬宣王泝漢水，當會南鄭。諸軍或從斜谷道，或從武威入。會大霖雨三十餘日，或棧道斷絕，詔真還軍。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Cáo] Zhēn as a youth with his clansman Cáo Zūn and fellow villager Zhū Zàn together served Tàizǔ. [Cáo] Zūn and [Zhū] Zàn early died, [Cáo] Zhēn pitied this, and begged to divide his income estate to enfeoff [Cáo] Zūn's and [Zhū] Zàn's sons. Edict said: "The Marshal-in-Chief has the benevolence of Shūxiàng's caring for orphans,^[Shūxiàng was a Spring and Autumn era Jìn state man who cared for the orphans of a decease colleague.] maintains the relationship of Yàn Píng's long time friendship.^[Píng was the posthumous name of Yàn Yīng, a Spring and Autumn era Qí state man. He reportedly took care to maintain steadfast loyalty to lifetime friends through changing fortunes.] A noble man completes the beauties of others, listen and divide [Cáo] Zhēn's estate to bestow on [Cáo] Zūn's and [Zhū] Zàn's sons noble titles as Marquesses Within the Passes, each one hundred households." [Cáo] Zhēn every time in going out on campaign with his officers and servicemen shared in the labors and toils, if the army rewards were not enough, at once he used his family wealth to provide for bestowals, the soldiers all were willing to be of use to him. [Cáo] Zhēn was ill and returned to Luòyáng, the Emperor personally visited his mansion to check on his illness. [Cáo] Zhēn died, posthumous name called Yuán-hóu. His son [Cáo] Shuǎng succeeded. The Emperor recalled [Cáo] Zhēn's achievements, Edict said: "The Marshal-in-Chief walked in loyalty and integrity, assisted the Mandate of the Two Founders, inside did not rely on the favors given for kin, outside was not arrogant to servicemen of plain houses, he can be said to be one capable of upholding the full and maintaining position, laboring modestly as his virtue. Thus all enfeoff five of [Cáo] Zhēn's sons [Cáo] Xī, [Cáo] Xùn, [Cáo] Zé, [Cáo] Yàn, [Cáo] Ái all as Ranked Marquesses." Previously, Emperor Wén divided from [Cáo] Zhēn's estate two hundred households to enfeoff [Cáo] Zhēn's younger brother [Cáo] Bīn as a Ranked Marquess.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
真少與宗人曹遵、鄉人朱讚並事太祖。遵、讚早亡，真愍之，乞分所食邑封遵、讚子。詔曰：「大司馬有叔向撫孤之仁，篤晏平久要之分。君子成人之美，聽分真邑賜遵、讚子爵關內侯，各百戶。」真每征行，與將士同勞苦，軍賞不足，輒以家財班賜，士卒皆願為用。真病還洛陽，帝自幸其第省疾。真薨，諡曰元侯。子爽嗣。帝追思真功，詔曰：「大司馬蹈履忠節，佐命二祖，內不恃親戚之寵，外不驕白屋之士，可謂能持盈守位，勞謙其德者也。其悉封真五子羲、訓、則、彥、皚皆為列侯。」初，文帝分真邑二百戶，封真弟彬為列侯。
:::
:::

### Cáo Shuǎng {.unnumbered #caoshuang}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Cáo] Shuǎng appellation Zhāobó, from youth as a careful and dignified clansman, when Emperor Míng was at the East Palace he was extremely close with and favored him. Reaching to the succession to the throne, became Cavalier Attendant Cadet, gradually promoted to City Gate Colonel, added Cavalier Regular Attendant, transferred to Martial Guard General, favored and treated with exceptional distinction. The Emperor was lying ill, thus summoned [Cáo] Shuǎng to enter the bedroom, appointed General-in-Chief, Lent Stave and Battle-Ax, Overall Supervisor of Central and External various military affairs, managing Secretariat Writer affairs, with Grand Commandant Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng together received Legacy Edict to assist the Young Ruler. Emperor Míng passed away, the King of Qí succeeded the throne, added to [Cáo] Shuǎng Attendant Central, changed fief to Marquess of Wǔ'ān, estate twelve thousand households, bestowed of honor to with sword and shoes ascend Halls, enter Court without hastening, announced without using personal name. Dīng Mì devised a plan, having [Cáo] Shuǎng inform Heaven's Son, to issue an Edict to transfer [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng to be Grand Tutor, outside to use the title honor him, inside wishing to have Secretariat Writer memorial affairs first come through himself, to be able to control their lightness or severity. <a href="#annotation-25" id="source-25">[25]</a> [Cáo] Shuǎng's younger brothers [Cáo] Xī became Central Manager of the Army, [Cáo] Xuǹ Martial Guard General, [Cáo] Yàn Cavalier Regular Attendant and Attendant to Lectures, the remaining various younger brothers, all as Ranked Marquesses followed in attendance, exiting and entering the restricted doors, in nobility and favor none could surpass them. Nányáng's Hé Yàn, Dèng Yáng, Lǐ Shèng, Pèi state's Dīng Mì, Dōngpíng's Bì Guǐ all had fame, sought advancement at the time, Emperor Míng believed them superficial and pretentious, restrained and dismissed them all. Reaching to [Cáo] Shuǎng controlling the government, then he again advanced and employed them, appointed as belly and heart. [Dèng] Yáng and the rest wished to have [Cáo] Shuǎng establish authority and fame to Heaven's Under, urged him to attack Shǔ, [Cáo] Shuǎng followed their advice, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng opposed but could not prohibit it. Zhèngshǐ Fifth Year [244], [Cáo] Shuǎng thus went west reaching Cháng'ān, greatly mobilized soldiers of sixty to seventy thousand men, from Luò valley entering. At the time, the transferred transports from Guānzhōng and the Dī and Qiāng could not supply them, of the oxen and horses and mules and donkeys many died, the civilians and Yí wailed and sobbed on the roads. Entered the valley and traveled several hundred lǐ, the rebels took advantage of the mountains to be firm, the troops could not advance. [Cáo] Shuǎng's Advisor to the Army Yáng Wěi explained the circumstances to [Cáo] Shuǎng, that it was appropriate to urgently return, and if not then they would be defeated. <a href="#annotation-26" id="source-26">[26]</a> [Dèng] Yáng and [Yáng] Wěi fought in front of [Cáo] Shuǎng, [Yáng] Wěi said: "[Dèng] Yáng and [Lǐ] Shèng will ruin the country's affairs, they can be beheaded." [Cáo] Shuǎng was displeased, and so withdrew the army to return. <a href="#annotation-27" id="source-27">[27]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
爽字昭伯，少以宗室謹重，明帝在東宮，甚親愛之。及即位，為散騎侍郎，累遷城門校尉，加散騎常侍，轉武衛將軍，寵待有殊。帝寢疾，乃引爽入臥內，拜大將軍，假節鉞，都督中外諸軍事，錄尚書事，與太尉司馬宣王並受遺詔輔少主。明帝崩，齊王即位，加爽侍中，改封武安侯，邑萬二千戶，賜劍履上殿，入朝不趨，贊拜不名。丁謐畫策，使爽白天子，發詔轉宣王為太傅，外以名號尊之，內欲令尚書奏事，先來由己，得制其輕重也。〔一〕爽弟羲為中領軍，訓武衛將軍，彥散騎常侍侍講，其餘諸弟，皆以列侯侍從，出入禁闥，貴寵莫盛焉。南陽何晏、鄧颺、李勝、沛國丁謐、東平畢軌咸有聲名，進趣於時，明帝以其浮華，皆抑黜之；及爽秉政，乃復進敘，任為腹心。颺等欲令爽立威名於天下，勸使伐蜀，爽從其言，宣王止之不能禁。正始五年，爽乃西至長安，大發卒六七萬人，從駱谷入。是時，關中及氐、羌轉輸不能供，牛馬騾驢多死，民夷號泣道路。入谷行數百里，賊因山為固，兵不得進。爽參軍楊偉為爽陳形勢，宜急還，不然將敗。〔二〕颺與偉爭於爽前，偉曰：「颺、勝將敗國家事，可斬也。」爽不悅，乃引軍還。〔三〕

<a href="#source-25" id="annotation-25">[25]</a> Wèi shū states: [Cáo] Shuǎng sent his younger brother [Cáo] Xī to make a memorial that said: "Your Servant's late father [Cáo] Zhēn served Three Courts, in entering filled in as a senior minister, in exiting was a high officer. The Former Emperor because Your Servant was the heir of a close confidant,^[Fèi fǔ yí xù, literally "legacy thread of lungs and bowels."] encouraged and selected me, to organize troops in the Restricted Ministries. In advancing without loyal and respectful accumualted conduct, in withdrawing without the integrity of Gāoyáng's "from the public,"^[Gāoyáng is a song in the Shījīng. The relevant phrase "from the public" (zì gōng) is a term for frugality, deriving from a lyric of an official leaving Court to return home to eat his own private food rather than eat from public resources.] The Former Emperor's sagely body was unwell, though Your Servant rushed and ran, attending to the illness and tasting the medicine, there was no response to the thorough sincerity on the next day, and I the lowly one with the Grand Commandant [Sīmǎ] Yì together received the Legacy Edict, ashamed and afraid, with nowhere to express it. Your Servant has heard that when Yú Shùn ranked the worthy he had Jì and Qì as the first, that when Chéng Tāng commended achievements he had Yī and Lǚ as the head. To carefully select and widely recommend, the good and the bad in their place, this truly is the great principle for assisting the world and expanding the people, the excellent canon for nothing merits and rewarding achievements, from antiquity onward, never having omission. Now Your Servant is empty and ignorant, position crowning the head of Court, looking back to consider the surpassing of sequence, my heart is ashamed and afraid, I dare exhaust my foolish feelings to explain and write the utmost truth. The observed ways of Heaven's Under are three, called virtue, nobility, and age. [Sīmǎ] Yì originally for high enlightenment and correct uprightness occupied position of highest minister, fame sufficient to calm the masses, righteousness sufficient to lead subordinates, this is first. He embraces the grand strategy, fully civil fully martial, repeatedly established campaign achievements, far and near assign credit, this is second. Across ten thousand lǐ turning his banners, he personally received the Legacy Edict, supporting and shining the Imperial House, the interior and exterior turn to him, this is third. Adding to this his senior age,^[The term here is qí ài. Qí is a term for someone in their sixties, Ài in their fifties.] experienced in regulating country and state, familiar with refining Court and government. In discussing virtue then he surpasses Jí Fǔ and Fán Zhòng, in examining achievements then he exceeds Fāng Shū and Shào Hǔ. Altogether in these several, [Sīmǎ] Yì truly has them all. Your Servant carries an empty name but yet resides to his right, the people of Heaven's Under will say that Your Servant as a clansman meets with selfish favor, knows to advance but does not know to withdraw. Your Majesty is precociously intelligence, capable of understanding capable of categorization,^[This phrase kè míng kè lèi is from the song Huáng Yǐ in the Shījīng.] if there is examination of Your Servant's words, Your Servant believes it appropriate for [Sīmǎ] Yì to be Grand Tutor and Marshal-in-Chief, above to make clear Your Majesty's enlightenment in advancing worthies, in the middle to make prominent [Sīmǎ] Yì's embodiment of true civil and martial ability, below to allow Your Humble Servant to escape slander and ridicule." Thereupon the Emperor sent Central Writers Overseer Liú Fàng and Director Sūn Zī to make Edict that said: "In the past Wú Hàn aided Guāng-Wǔ, having the achievement of campaigning and settling the Four Quarters, became Marshal-in-Chief, his name praised to the present. The Grand tutor embodies and treads the correct and upright, achievements cover Within the Seas, the Former Emperor originally beginning to end had wishes to change his position but always not enough time had passed, and therefore it was delayed and not put into effect. Now the General-in-Chief recommends that the Grand Commandant should be Marshal-in-Chief, it already accords with the Former Emperor's original intentions, and also demonstrates deferrence, advances virtue and esteems accomplishments, and so wishes to make clear the worthy and good, distinguish hierarchy and rank, and comply with seniority and junior. Even the likes of Dàn and Shì treated Lǚ Wàng as exemplar and teacher, attention on craning neck to reside beneath him, how could it surpass this? We extremely commend it. We consider that the Former Emperor assuredly understood that the noble man delights in Heaven and knows its mandates, minute and triffling doubts are not sufficient for concern, should have considered the examples of Bǎi Rén and Péng Wáng, and therefore employed deliberation and hesitation, having intentions that were not fulfilled. This also was the Former Emperor's heavy respect for a chief minister, the utmost of deep and generous grace and affection. In the past King Chéng established the offices of Protector and Tutor, more recently Hàn Xiǎnzōng appointed Dèng Yǔ as Grand Tutor, all in order to exceptionally esteem the outstanding, to be certain to have honor. Thus appoint the Grand Commandant as Grand Tutor."

〔一〕　魏書曰：爽使弟羲為表曰：「臣亡父真，奉事三朝，入備冢宰，出為上將。先帝以臣肺腑遺緒，獎飭拔擢，典兵禁省，進無忠恪積累之行，退無羔羊自公之節。先帝聖體不豫，臣雖奔走，侍疾嘗藥，曾無精誠翼日之應，猥與太尉懿俱受遺詔，且慚且懼，靡所厎告。臣聞虞舜序賢，以稷、契為先，成湯褒功，以伊、呂為首，審選博舉，優劣得所，斯誠輔世長民之大經，錄勳報功之令典，自古以來，未之或闕。今臣虛闇，位冠朝首，顧惟越次，中心愧惕，敢竭愚情，陳寫至實。夫天下之達道者三，謂德、爵、齒也。懿本以高明中正，處上司之位，名足鎮眾，義足率下，一也。包懷大略，允文允武，仍立征伐之勳，遐邇歸功，二也。萬里旋旆，親受遺詔，翼亮皇家，內外所向，三也。加之耆艾，紀綱邦國，體練朝政；論德則過於吉甫、樊仲；課功則踰於方叔、召虎：凡此數者，懿實兼之。臣抱空名而處其右，天下之人將謂臣以宗室見私，知進而不知退。陛下岐嶷，克明克類，如有以察臣之言，臣以為宜以懿為太傅、大司馬，上昭陛下進賢之明，中顯懿身文武之實，下使愚臣免於謗誚。」於是帝使中書監劉放令孫資為詔曰：「昔吳漢佐光武，有征定四方之功，為大司馬，名稱于今。太尉體履正直，功蓋海內，先帝本以前後欲更其位者輒不彌久，是以遲遲不施行耳。今大將軍薦太尉宜為大司馬，既合先帝本旨，又放推讓，進德尚勳，乃欲明賢良、辯等列、順長少也。雖旦、奭之屬，宗師呂望，念在引領以處其下，何以過哉！朕甚嘉焉。朕惟先帝固知君子樂天知命，纖芥細疑，不足為忌，當顧柏人彭亡之文，故用低佪，有意未遂耳！斯亦先帝敬重大臣，恩愛深厚之至也。昔成王建保傅之官，近漢顯宗以鄧禹為太傅，皆所以優崇雋乂，必有尊也。其以太尉為太傅。」
:::

<a href="#source-26" id="annotation-26">[26]</a> Shìyǔ states: [Yáng] Wěi appellation Shìyīng was a Féngyì man. When Emperor Míng was repairing Palace Residences, [Yáng] Wěi remonstrated stating: "Now to build Palace Residences is to chop down the pines and cypresses above the graves of the people, destroy the stele statues and stone pillars, a crime that reaches the deceased, injures the hearts of filial children, it cannot be an example for later generations."

〔二〕　世語曰：偉字世英，馮翊人。明帝治宮室，偉諫曰：「今作宮室，斬伐生民墓上松柏，毀壞碑獸石柱，辜及亡人，傷孝子心，不可以為後世之法則。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-27" id="annotation-27">[27]</a> Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: Sīmǎ Xuān-wáng spoke to Xiàhóu Xuán^[This account creates a problem in that Sīmǎ Xuān-wáng is Sīmǎ Yì, who did not participate in the campaign and therefore could not have spoken to Xiàhóu Xuán. Zīzhì Tōngjiàn attempts to resolve the discrepancy by changing this account to a letter rather than a conversation. Jìn shū instead claims that Sīmǎ Xuān-wáng should be Sīmǎ Wén-wáng, or Sīmǎ Zhāo, who did accompany the campaign as Xiàhóu Xuán's second in command.] stating: "The Chūnqiū places heaviest responsibilities on the greatest virtues. In the past that Wǔ Huángdì in the second time entering Hànzhōng almost reached to great defeat, you know. Now Xīngpíng's roads and terrain are of utmost ruggedness, Shǔ already in advance occupied. If in advancing one cannot obtain battle, retreating meets with interception and cutting off, the overturning of the army is certain. How would you bear the responsibility?" [Xiàhóu] Xuán was afraid, spoke to [Cáo] Shuǎng, withdrew the army to retreat. Fèi Yī advanced troops to occupy Sānlǐng to intercept [Cáo] Shuǎng, [Cáo] Shuǎng contested the rugged terrain in bitter battle, only barely then able to pass. The mobilized oxen and horses for transports died or were lost almost completely, the Qiāng and Hú sighed in resentment, and west of the passes was completely emptied and depleted.^[Zīzhì Tōngjiàn somewhat rewrites the account given here to delete "the mobilize oxen and horses," which has probably led to the popular belief that the west of the passes was depopulated of people.]
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　漢晉春秋曰：司馬宣王謂夏侯玄曰：「春秋責大德重，昔武皇帝再入漢中，幾至大敗，君所知也。今興平路勢至險，蜀已先據；若進不獲戰，退見徼絕，覆軍必矣。將何以任其責！」玄懼，言於爽，引軍退。費禕進兵據三嶺以截爽，爽爭嶮苦戰，僅乃得過。所發牛馬運轉者，死失略盡，羌、胡怨嘆，而關右悉虛耗矣。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, [Cáo] Shuǎng believed [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng's years and virtue were both high, always treated him like a father, not daring to act alone. Reaching to when [Hé] Yàn and the rest were advanced and employed, they all together endorsed him, persuading [Cáo] Shuǎng that heavy authority should not be entrusted to others. Thus appointed [Hé] Yàn, [Dèng] Yáng, [Dīng] Mì as Secretariat Writers, [Hé] Yàn managed selections and recommendations, [Bì] Guǐ Director of Retainers Colonel, [Lǐ] Shèng Hénán Intendant, various affairs were rarely ever through [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng therefore claimed illness and avoided [Cáo] Shuǎng. <a href="#annotation-28" id="source-28">[28]</a> [Hé] Yàn and the rest controlled the government, together divided and partitioned Luòyáng's and Yěwáng's Manager of Agriculture's division's mulberry farm fields of several hundred qǐng, reaching to demolishing the Tāngmù lands to be private estates,^[Tāngmù was land used for revenue for fiefs within the royal domain, particularly for fiefs for in-laws and princesses.] used their influence to steal government objects, took advantage of circumstances to make requests from the provinces and prefectures. The relevant managers watched the winds, none daring to disobey their wishes. [Hé] Yàn and the rest with Minister of Justice Lú Yù formerly were not at peace, took advantage of [Lú] Yù's clerk having a minor transgression, with harsh words sent [Lú] Yù to the law,^[The term rendered as "harsh words" is shēn wén, which is to use an excessively harsh and distorted interpretation of written law for entrapment.] having the manager in advance confiscate [Lú] Yù's seal and ribbon and only afterwards memorializing report. Their creation of power was like this.^["Creation of power" (zuō wēi) is a term referring to the monarch's authority to order punishments and executions.] [Cáo] Shuǎng's drink and food and chariots and clothing imitated the Chariot Carriage,^[Chariot Carriage (chéngyú) originally was one of the Emperor's chariots and became a euphemism for the Emperor's person.] Rare treasures from the Secretariat Crafters^[Secretariat Crafters (shàngfāng) were master artisans employed by the Imperial Palace to craft objects for the Imperial family.] filled his house, wives and concubines filled his Rear Court, and also he privately took the Former Emperor's Talent Ladies^[Talent Ladies (cáirén) were a rank in the Imperial harem. Based on the name presumably they were employed for various skills and arts.] of seven to eight women, with officers and clerks and master artisans and drummers and trumpeters and daughters of elite families of thirty-three people, all to be his performers and musicians. He falsely made Edict letters to send Talent Ladies of fifty seven people to Yè Terrace, having the Former Emperor's beauties^[The exact term used here is Jiéyú, a rank in the Imperial harem] instruct and train them into performers. He usurped authority to take the Grand Musician's musical instruments, the Military Arsenal's restricted weapons. He made an underground room, engraved windows on all four sides, repeatedly with [Hé] Yàn and the rest gathering inside, drinking alcohol and making merry. [Cáo] Xī deeply believed it a great worry, repeatedly remonstrated to stop it, also wrote a book in three fascicle,^[The term translated as "fascicle" here is piān, which refers to a set of bamboo writing strips bound together into a rollable bundle.] explaining how arrogance and excessiveness attracks disaster and destruction, its statements and intentions extremely cutting, did not dare reprimand [Cáo] Shuǎng, and claimed it was to admonish their various younger brothers in order to show it to [Cáo] Shuǎng. [Cáo] Shuǎng knew it was directed at himself, was extremely displeased. [Cáo] Xī at some times because his remonstrations and explanations were not accepted, shed tears and rose to leave. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng secretly made preparations against them. Ninth Year [248] Winter, Lǐ Shèng was sent out to be Jīng Province Inspector, went to visit [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng claimed his illness was serious, showing an emaciated appearance. [Lǐ] Shèng was not aware, and said it was true. <a href="#annotation-28" id="source-29">[29]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，爽以宣王年德並高，恆父事之，不敢專行。及晏等進用，咸共推戴，說爽以權重不宜委之於人。乃以晏、颺、謐為尚書，晏典選舉，軌司隸校尉，勝河南尹，諸事希復由宣王。宣王遂稱疾避爽〔一〕。晏等專政，共分割洛陽、野王典農部桑田數百頃，及壞湯沐地以為產業，承勢竊取官物，因緣求欲州郡。有司望風，莫敢忤旨。晏等與廷尉盧毓素有不平，因毓吏微過，深文致毓法，使主者先收毓印綬，然後奏聞。其作威如此。爽飲食車服，擬於乘輿；尚方珍玩，充牣其家；妻妾盈後庭，又私取先帝才人七八人，及將吏、師工、鼓吹、良家子女三十三人，皆以為伎樂。詐作詔書，發才人五十七人送鄴臺，使先帝婕妤教習為伎。擅取太樂樂器，武庫禁兵。作窟室，綺疏四周，數與晏等會其中，飲酒作樂。羲深以為大憂，數諫止之。又著書三篇，陳驕淫盈溢之致禍敗，辭旨甚切，不敢斥爽，託戒諸弟以示爽。爽知其為己發也，甚不悅。羲或時以諫喻不納，涕泣而起。宣王密為之備。九年冬，李勝出為荊州刺史，往詣宣王。宣王稱疾困篤，示以羸形。勝不能覺，謂之信然。〔二〕
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-28" id="annotation-28">[28]</a> Previously, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng believed [Cáo] Shuǎng was as Wèi's lungs and bowels and always deferred to palce him ahead, [Cáo] Shuǎng believed [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng's fame was heavy, and also withdrew himself to be humble and beneath him. At the time they were praised. When Dīng Mì and Bì Guǐ and the rest were advanced and employed, they repeatedly spoke to [Cáo] Shuǎng stating: "[Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng has great ambitions and has greatly obtained the people's hearts, you cannot defer to and sincerely entrust him." Because of this [Cáo] Shuǎng always was suspicious and on guard. Although the appearances of courtesy was preserved, yet in various activities and actions, all were no longer through [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng's strenght was unable to contest it, and moreover fearing the disaster, therefore he avoided him.^[The source citation for this annotation seems to have been lost, unfortunately.]
:::

::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　初，宣王以爽魏之肺腑，每推先之，爽以宣王名重，亦引身卑下，當時稱焉。丁謐、畢軌等既進用，數言于爽曰：「宣王有大志而甚得民心，不可以推誠委之。」由是爽恆猜防焉。禮貌雖存，而諸所興造，皆不復由宣王。宣王力不能爭，且懼其禍，故避之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-29" id="annotation-29">[29]</a> Wèi Mò zhuàn states: [Cáo] Shuǎng and the rest ordered [Lǐ] Shèng to take leave of [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng, and also spy and examine him. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng met [Lǐ] Shèng, [Lǐ] Shèng explained himself as having no other achievements, undeservedly covered in special favor, about to return to his home province, and had visited the doors to take leave, not expecting to be given the favor to be able to be granted an audience. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng had two maids attending at his side, holding his clothes, his clothes fell. He further pointed up at his mouth, saying he was thirsty and requested a drink, the maid advanced porridge, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng held a cup to drink the porridge, the porridge all spilled out to stain his chest. [Lǐ] Shèng pitied this, shedding tears for this, spoke to [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng stating: "Now the Ruler Above is still young, Heaven's Under depends on Your Enlightened Excellency. However the masses all say Your Enlightened Excellency's old illness is spreading, how could one have thought your honored body would be like this!" [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng slowly further broadly spoke, just barely keeping his breath continuous, saying: "I am old and deeply ill, my death in mornings or evenings. You are about to be assigned to Bìng Province. Bìng Province is near the Hú, work well at it, I fear we will not meet again, what of it?" [Lǐ] Shèng said: "I am about to return to serve my home province, not Bìng Province."^["Home province" here is běnzhōu, which can sound close to "Bìng Province" bìngzhōu.] [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng then further acted confused and mistaken, stating: "You will arrive at Bìng Province, work hard and care for yourself!" He mixed and disordered his statements, acting as if inarticulate in speaking. [Lǐ] Shèng further said: "I am serving Jīng Province, not Bìng Province." [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng then acted as if slightly understanding, and spoke to [Lǐ] Shèng stating: "[I, Sīmǎ] Yì am old, thoughts inarticulate and neglectful, not undestanding your words. Now you return to be your Home Province's Inspector, flourishing in virtue and strong in intensity, well establish achievements and accomplishments. Now you and I will part, considering myself my spirit is becoming weak, later we certainly will not meet again, therefore I wished to exert myself, to serve as a meager host, for parting for both life and death. Let [my sons] the brothers [Sīmǎ] Shī and [Sīmǎ] Zhāo be joined with you as friends, you cannot abandon one another, to accord with [Sīmǎ] Yì's trifling heart." Therefore he shed tears and sobbed. [Lǐ] Shèng also deeply sighed, answered stating: "At once I will follow your instructions, pending orders and mandates." [Lǐ] Shèng took leave and went out, met with [Cáo] Shuǎng and the rest, saying: "The Grand Tutor's speech was confused and mistaken, his mouth could not hold his cup, pointing south and calling it north. He also said I would about to serve in Bìng Province, I answered I was about to return to serve in Jīng Province, not Bìng Province. Slowly and gradually speaking with him, he had a time of clarity, and only then understood I was about to return to serve in Jīng Province. Also he wished to set up a host's send-off. He cannot be abandoned, it is appropriate to wait and care for him." He further toward [Cáo] Shuǎng and the rest shed tears saying: "The Grand Tutor's illness cannot be again relieved, it makes one mournful."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏末傳曰：爽等令勝辭宣王，并伺察焉。宣王見勝，勝自陳無他功勞，橫蒙特恩，當為本州，詣閤拜辭，不悟加恩，得蒙引見。宣王令兩婢侍邊，持衣，衣落；復上指口，言渴求飲，婢進粥，宣王持盃飲粥，粥皆流出沾胸。勝愍然，為之涕泣，謂宣王曰：「今主上尚幼，天下恃賴明公。然眾情謂明公方舊風疾發，何意尊體乃爾！」宣王徐更寬言，才令氣息相屬，說：「年老沈疾，死在旦夕。君當屈并州，并州近胡，好善為之，恐不復相見，如何！」勝曰：「當還忝本州，非并州也。」宣王乃復陽為昏謬，曰：「君方到并州，努力自愛！」錯亂其辭，狀如荒語。勝復曰：「當忝荊州，非并州也。」宣王乃若微悟者，謂勝曰：「懿年老，意荒忽，不解君言。今還為本州刺史，盛德壯烈，好建功勳。今當與君別，自顧氣力轉微，後必不更會，因欲自力，設薄主人，生死共別。令師、昭兄弟結君為友，不可相舍去，副懿區區之心。」因流涕哽咽。勝亦長嘆，答曰：「輒當承教，須待敕命。」勝辭出，與爽等相見，說：「太傅語言錯誤，口不攝杯，指南為北。又云吾當作并州，吾答言當還為荊州，非并州也。徐徐與語，有識人時，乃知當還為荊州耳。又欲設主人祖送。不可舍去，宜須待之。」更向爽等垂淚云：「太傅患不可復濟，令人愴然。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Tenth Year Standard Moon [249 Jan 31 - Feb 28], the Chariot Carriage held Court at Gāopínglíng, [Cáo] Shuǎng and his brothers all following. <a href="#annotation-30" id="source-30">[30]</a> [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng organized divisions of troops and horses, first occupied the Military Arsenal, then set out to garrison the Luò river's pontoon bridges. The memorial against [Cáo] Shuǎng said: "Your Servant in the past from Liáodōng returned, the Former Emperor had Edict on Your Majesty and the King of Qín with Your Servant to ascend to the Imperial bed, grasped Your Servant's arm, deeply concerned with later affairs. Your Servant said: 'The Two Founders also entrusted Your Servant with later affairs. This Your Majesty personally saw, there is nothing to worry or suffer about. Ten thousand to one if there is anything not as you intend, Your Servant will with my death serve your Enlightened Edict.' The Yellow Gate Director Dǒng Jī and the rest, the Talent Ladies and attendants to the illness, all heard and know of this. Now the General-in-Chief [Cáo] Shuǎng turns back on and abandons the legacy mandate, ruins and disorders state canon, inside then usurps and imitates, outside concentrates authority and power, destroys the various camps, completely seizing the Restricted Troops, the various offices and criticial positions are all filled by his intimates, Inside the Halls and the Residential Guard, the long serving men through successive generations all were also dismissed and excelled, wishing to install new men to cultivate his personal plans, his roots occupy and twist together, his lack of restraint daily grows more extreme. With the exterior already like this, he also appointed the Yellow Gate Zhāng Dāng as supervisor overseer, to control all interactions, watching the Utmost Honored, spying on the Divine Vessels, estranging the Two Palaces, injuring bone and flesh.^[Two Palaces refer to the Emperor and the Dowager Empress. Bone and flesh refer to biological family relationships. Its use here is probably a rather crude propaganda, as the Emperor Cáo Fāng was not an actual biological, or "bone and flesh," son of the Dowager Empress.] Heaven's Under is in turmoil, people filled with apprehension and dread, Your Majesty is only filling a seat, how can there be long-term security? This is not the original intention of the Former Emperor's Edict on Your Majesty and Your Servant to ascend to the Imperial bed. Although Your Servant is decrepit and old, dare I forget the past^[The translation as "past" is from interpreting wǎng 枉 as an equivalent variant of (or an error for) wǎng 往.] words? In the past Zhào Gāo had extreme intentions, the Qín clan was thus exterminated.^[Zhào Gāo was the overly powerful Chancellor during the downfall of Qín, who dominated the government to the point that he was able to arrange for the death of the Qín Second Emperor. The incorrect popular belief that Zhào Gāo was a eunuch seems to derive from a Táng dynasty era misunderstanding.] Lǚ and Huò were early cut off, Hàn's blessings endured throught the ages.^[The Lǚ clan dominated the Hàn government through the Dowager Empress Lǚ after the death of Hàn Emperor Gāo, but was overthrown and exterminated soon after the Dowager's death. The Huò clan dominated Hàn through the powerful regent Huò Guāng after the death of Hàn Emperor Wǔ, but was overthrown and exterminated soon after Huò Guāng's death.] This then is a great reflection for Your Majesty, the time for Your Servant to receive command. Grand Commandant Your Servant [Jiǎng] Jì, Secretariat Writers Director Your Servant [Sīmǎ] Fú and others all believe that [Cáo] Shuǎng has a heart without loyalty to lord, his brothers should not manage the troops and the Residential Guard, and memorialized the Yǒngníng Palace.^[Yǒngníng Palace was the Palace of the Dowager Empress.] The Imperial Dowager Empress ordered Your Servant to by the memorial put it into effect. Your Servant at once ordered the managers and the Yellow Gate Director to dismiss the clerks and troops of [Cáo] Shuǎng, [Cáo] Xī, [Cáo] Xùn, with them to as Marquesses go to their mansions, to not remain to delay the Chariot Carriage. If any dare to delay and remain, then by Military Law handle the affair. Your Servant at once forces through my illness to lead troops to garrison the Luò river pontoon bridge, to watch for the out of the ordinary." <a href="#annotation-31" id="source-31">[31]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
十年正月，車駕朝高平陵，爽兄弟皆從。〔一〕宣王部勒兵馬，先據武庫，遂出屯洛水浮橋。奏爽曰：「臣昔從遼東還，先帝詔陛下、秦王及臣升御床，把臣臂，深以後事為念。臣言『二祖亦屬臣以後事，（為念）此自陛下所見，無所憂苦；萬一有不如意，臣當以死奉明詔』。黃門令董箕等，才人侍疾者，皆所聞知。今大將軍爽背棄顧命，敗亂國典，內則僭擬，外專威權；破壞諸營，盡據禁兵，群官要職，皆置所親；殿中宿衛，歷世舊人皆復斥出，欲置新人以樹私計；根據槃互，縱恣日甚。外既如此，又以黃門張當為都監，專共交關，看察至尊，侯伺神器，離間二宮，傷害骨肉。天下洶洶，人懷危懼，陛下但為寄坐，豈得久安！此非先帝詔陛下及臣升御床之本意也。臣雖朽邁，敢忘枉言？昔趙高極意，秦氏以滅；呂、霍早斷，漢祚永世。此乃陛下之大鑒，臣受命之時也。太尉臣濟、尚書令臣孚等，皆以爽為有無君之心，兄弟不宜典兵宿衛，奏永寧宮。皇太后令敕臣如奏施行。臣輒敕主者及黃門令罷爽、羲、訓吏兵，以侯就第，不得逗留以稽車駕；敢有稽留，便以軍法從事。臣輒力疾，將兵屯洛水浮橋，伺察非常。」〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-30" id="annotation-30">[30]</a> Shìyǔ states: [Cáo] Shuǎng and his brothers before this repeatedly all together went out, Huán Fàn spoke to them stating: "Presiding over all matters, managing the Restricted Troops, it is not appropriate to all together go out. If there is a closing of the City Gates, who will again let you inside?" [Cáo] Shuǎng said: "Who would dare do so?" Because of this they no longer all together went. Reaching to this then they completely went out.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　世語曰：爽兄弟先是數俱出游，桓範謂曰：「總萬機，典禁兵，不宜並出，若有閉城門，誰復內入者？」爽曰：「誰敢爾邪！」由此不復並行。至是乃盡出也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-31" id="annotation-31">[31]</a> Shìyǔ states: Previously, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng organized troops from below the palace watchtowers to hasten to the Military Arsenal, reaching [Cáo] Shuǎng's gates, people forced the chariot to stop. [Cáo] Shuǎng's wife Liú was afraid, went out to the office, and spoke to the bannermen defending supervisor stating: "His Excellency is outside, now troops are rising, what to do?" The supervisor said: "Madam, do not worry." Then he went up the gate towers, drew crossbow and notched arrow wishing to shoot. Officer Sūn Qiān at the rear pulled back and stopped him stating: "Heaven's Under's affairs cannot yet be known!" It was like this three times, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng then was able to pass through.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　世語曰：初，宣王勒兵從闕下趨武庫，當爽門，人逼車住。爽妻劉怖，出至廳事，謂帳下守督曰：「公在外。今兵起，如何？」督曰：「夫人勿憂。」乃上門樓，引弩注箭欲發。將孫謙在後牽止之曰：「天下事未可知！」如此者三，宣王遂得過去。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Cáo] Shuǎng obtained [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng's memorialized matter, did not pass it on, pressured and distressed not knowing what to do. <a href="#annotation-32" id="source-32">[32]</a> Minister of Agriculture Pèi state's Huán Fàn heard troops were rising, did not answer the Dowager Empress's summons, falsely claimed Edict to open Píngchāng Gate, seized and took sword and halberd, captured and led the Gate guards, fled south to [Cáo] Shuǎng. When [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng learned of it, he said: "[Huán] Fàn can draw up strategies, but [Cáo] Shuǎng certainly is unable to employ [Huán] Fàn's plans." [Huán] Fàn advised [Cáo] Shuǎng to have the Chariot Carriage visit Xǔchāng and summon exterior troops. [Cáo] Shuǎng and his brothers yet hesitated and were undecided. [Huán] Fàn repeatedly spoke to [Cáo] Xī stating: "From today, even if your household requested to again be poor and lowly, could you obtain it? Moreover even a common fellow would hold a hostage of one man, yet hoping to survive, now you and Heaven's Son are accompanying one another, in sending orders to Heaven's Under, who would dare not answer?" [Cáo] Xī yet could not accept this. Attendant Central Xǔ Yǔn and Secretariat Writer Chén Tài advised [Cáo] Shuǎng to have him early submit himself to punishment. [Cáo] Shuǎng thereupon sent [Xǔ] Yǔn and [Chén] Tài to visit [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng to accept punishment and request death, and so passed on [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng's memorialized matter. <a href="#annotation-33" id="source-33">[33]</a> Therefore dismissed [Cáo] Shuǎng and his brothers, to as Marquesses reeturn to their mansions. <a href="#annotation-34" id="source-34">[34]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
爽得宣王奏事，不通，迫窘不知所為。〔一〕大司農沛國桓範聞兵起，不應太后召，矯詔開平昌門，拔取劍戟，略將門候，南奔爽。宣王知，曰：「範畫策，爽必不能用範計。」範說爽使車駕幸許昌，招外兵。爽兄弟猶豫未決，範重謂羲曰：「當今日，卿門戶求貧賤復可得乎？且匹夫持質一人，尚欲望活，今卿與天子相隨，令於天下，誰敢不應者？」羲猶不能納。侍中許允、尚書陳泰說爽，使早自歸罪。爽於是遣允、泰詣宣王，歸罪請死，乃通宣王奏事。〔二〕遂免爽兄弟，以侯還第。〔三〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-32" id="annotation-32">[32]</a> Gān Bǎo's Jìn jì states: [Cáo] Shuǎng kept the Chariot Carriage for the night at the Yī river's south, cut down trees to make abatis, mobilized garrison armored troops of several thousand men to be a guard.

Wèi Mò zhuàn states: [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng spoke to his younger brother [Sīmǎ] Fú: "His Majesty is outside and cannot be exposed in the night, quickly send tents and the Grand Kitchen food and utensils^[The Grand Kitchen (tàiguān) was responsible for the Emperor's food and meals.] to visit where he is traveling."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　干寶晉紀曰：爽留車駕宿伊水南，伐木為鹿角，發屯甲兵數千人以為衛。魏末傳曰：宣王語弟孚，陛下在外不可露宿，促送帳幔、太官食具詣行在所。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-33" id="annotation-33">[33]</a> Gān Bǎo's Jìn shū states: Huán Fàn went out to go to [Cáo] Shuǎng, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng spoke to Jiǎng Jì stating: "The bag of wisdom has gone." [Jiǎng] Jì said: "Fàn is indeed wise, but a worn out horse longs for stable beans, [Cáo] Shuǎng certainly is unable to employ him."

Shìyǔ states: [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng sent Xǔ Yǔn and Chén Tài to explain to and speak with [Cáo] Shuǎng, Jiǎng Jì also sent a letter to explain [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng's intentions, and also sent [Cáo] Shuǎng's trusted Hall Central Colonel Yǐn Dàmù to speak with [Cáo] Shuǎng, that it would only remove his office and nothing more, with the Luò river as a pledge. [Cáo] Shuǎng trusted it and dismissed his troops.

Wèi-shì Chūnqiū states: [Cáo] Shuǎng had dismissed his troops and said: "I will not lose out on being a wealthy old man." [Huán] Fàn wept and said: "Cáo Zǐdān was a great man, but begat you brothers, mere sacrificial calves! How could one have imagined that today in connection to you all the clan would be exterminated!"
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　干寶晉書曰：桓範出赴爽，宣王謂蔣濟曰：「智囊往矣。」濟曰：「範則智矣，駑馬戀棧豆，爽必不能用也。」世語曰：宣王使許允、陳泰解語爽，蔣濟亦與書達宣王之旨，又使爽所信殿中校尉尹大目謂爽，唯免官而已，以洛水為誓。爽信之，罷兵。魏氏春秋曰：爽既罷兵，曰：「我不失作富家翁。」範哭曰：「曹子丹佳人，生汝兄弟，犢耳！何圖今日坐汝等族滅矣！」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-34" id="annotation-34">[34]</a> Wèi Mò zhuàn states: [Cáo] Shuǎng and his brothers returned home. Ordered Luòyáng county to mobilize civilians of eight hundred people, sending the Commandant division to surround [Cáo] Shuǎng's mansion's four corners, at each corner building a high tower, sending people to the top to watch the activities of [Cáo] Shuǎng and his brothers. [Cáo] Shuǎng's plans were exhuated and he was in despair, holding a crossbow in arrived inside the Rear Garden, atop the towers people then chanted saying: "The former General-in-Chief goes southeast!" [Cáo] Shuǎng returned up to the office, with his brothers together discussed, not knowing how deep or shallow were [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng's intentions, wrote a letter to [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng that said: "Despicable boy [Cáo] Shuǎng is in dread and terror, in insolence incurred disaster, rightfully should receive slaughter and extermination, formerly sent household servants to welcome provisions, to now they have not yet returned, for several days we have been lacking, and must bother you to seek rations, to go through dawn and dusk." [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng obtained the letter and was greatly alarmed, at once sent answer letter that said: "Previously I was unaware that you lacked provisions, and extremely feel unsettled. Order to deliver rice of one hundred hú, together with dried meat, salted fermented beans, and soybeans." It was quickly sent. [Cáo] Shuǎng and his brothers did not understand the changing situations, were immediately joyous, themselves saying they would not die.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　魏末傳曰：爽兄弟歸家，敕洛陽縣發民八百人，使尉部圍爽第四角，角作高樓，令人在上望視爽兄弟舉動。爽計窮愁悶，持彈到後園中，樓上人便唱言「故大將軍東南行！」爽還廳事上，與兄弟共議，未知宣王意深淺，作書與宣王曰：「賤子爽哀惶恐怖，無狀招禍，分受屠滅，前遣家人迎糧，于今未反，數日乏匱，當煩見餉，以繼旦夕。」宣王得書大驚，即答書曰：「初不知乏糧，甚懷踧踖。令致米一百斛，并肉脯、鹽豉、大豆。」尋送。爽兄弟不達變數，即便喜歡，自謂不死。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, Zhāng Dāng privately selected Talent Ladies Zhāng and Hé and others to send to [Cáo] Shuǎng. Suspecting illicit relations, arrested [Zhāng] Dāng to punish the crime. [Zhāng] Dāng testified [Cáo] Shuǎng with [Hé] Yàn and the rest had secretly plotted rebellion, and together in advance trained troops, to wait for during the Third Moon to mobilize. Thereupon arrested [Hé] Yàn and the rest and sent down to prison. Assembled the Excellencies and Ministers and Court Councilors at the Courtyard to discuss, they believed: "By the principles of the Chūnqiū, 'The lord's kin do not command, if they command then they must be executed.' [Cáo] Shuǎng as a branch relation for generations was immerssed in exceptional favor, personally received the Former Emperor's hand grasping Legacy Edict, entrusted with Heaven's Under, but secretly harbored a disastrous heart, scorned and abandoned the legacy mandate, and so with [Hé] Yàn, [Dèng] Yáng, and [Zhāng] Dāng and the rest plotted for the Divine Vessels. [Huán] Fàn allied together with criminals. All are Great Rebellion Without Morality." Thereupon arrested [Cáo] Shuǎng, [Cáo] Xī, [Cáo] Xùn, [Hé] Yàn, [Dèng] Yáng, [Dīng] Mì, [Bì] Guǐ, [Lǐ] Shèng, [Huán] Fàn, [Zāng] Dāng and others, all submitted to execution, exterminated Three Clans.^[Extermination of the Three Clans (sān zú) was a mass execution of the criminal's family members as organized into three groups, generally reserved for cases of state treason. The definition of the Three Clans has varied between texts and times. Example definitions include: "father and mother, elder and younger brothers, wife and children;" "father's clan, mother's clan, wife's clan," and "father and his brothers, self and his brothers, son and his brothers." Qín had previously also defined a "Five Clans" and "Seven Clans," and from Suí onward there was a "Nine Clans."] <a href="#annotation-34" id="source-34">[34]</a> During Jiāpíng, to continue the lineages of meritorious ministers, enfeoffed [Cáo] Zhēn's cousin's grandson [Cáo] Xī as Marquess of Xīnchāng precinct, estate three hundred households, to serve as [Cáo] Zhēn's posterity. <a href="#annotation-35" id="source-35">[35]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，張當私以所擇才人張、何等與爽。疑其有姦，收當治罪。當陳爽與晏等陰謀反逆，並先習兵，須三月中欲發，於是收晏等下獄。會公卿朝臣廷議，以為「春秋之義，『君親無將，將而必誅』。爽以支屬，世蒙殊寵，親受先帝握手遺詔，託以天下，而包藏禍心，蔑棄顧命，乃與晏、颺及當等謀圖神器，範黨同罪人，皆為大逆不道」。於是收爽、羲、訓、晏、颺、謐、軌、勝、範、當等，皆伏誅，夷三族。〔一〕嘉平中，紹功臣世，封真族孫熙為新昌亭侯，邑三百戶，以奉真後。〔二〕

<a href="#source-34" id="annotation-34">[34]</a> Wèi lüè states:

Dèng Yáng appellation Xuánmào was Dèng Yǔ's posterity. As a youth he obtained a serviceman's reputation in the capital region. In Emperor Míng's time he became a Secretariat Writers Cadet, appointed Luòyáng Magistrate, in connection to a matter was dismissed, appointed Central Cadet, also entered as a concurrent Central Writers Cadet. Previously, [Dèng] Yáng with Lǐ Shèng and others were superficial and pretentious friends, reaching to when he was in the Central Writers, the superficial and pretentious matters were discovered, he was expelled out, and therefore no longer employed. At Zhèngshǐ's beginning, then he was sent out as Yǐngchuān Administrator, transferred to General-in-Chief's Chief Clerk, promoted to Attendant Central Secretariat Writer. [Dèng] Yáng as a man enjoyed money, formerly when in an inner office, he promised Zāng Ài a conferment with a prominent office, [Zāng] Ài had his father's concubine given to [Dèng] Yáng, therefore the capital region made it into a saying that stated: "For an office exchange a woman to Dèng Xuánmào." Of all those that he recommended and promoted, many were comparable to this. Therefore Hé Yàn in selections and recommendations not finding appropriate people tended to be due to [Dèng] Yáng's lack of fairnes and loyalty, thus they shared in the same crimes, overall because of associating with friends of improper talents.

Dīng Mì appellation Yànjìng. His father [Dīng] Fěi appellation Wénhóu. Previously, [Dīng] Fěi accompanied Tàizǔ, Tàizǔ because [Dīng] Fěi was of the same hometown specially tolerated and favored him. [Dīng] Fěi by nature enjoyed money, repeatedly made requests and violated laws, at once obtained pardon and forgiveness. Became Organizing Army Colonel, presiding over interior and exterior, of all that he explained and advised, many were followed. At Jiàn'ān's end, he followed Tàizǔ on campaign against Wú. [Dīng] Fěi while accompanying himself believed his family ox was lean and exhausted, and so privately exchanged it for a government ox, was reported by someone, and was arrested and sent to prison, taking away his office. Afterward Tàizǔ asked [Dīng] Fěi stating: "Wénhóu, where are your seal and ribbon?" [Dīng] Fěi also knew he was being teased, and replied stating: "I merely exchanged it for pastry." Tàizǔ laughed, looked back to speak with his Left and Right stating: " East Department Assistant Máo repeatedly reported this family, wishing to have me heavily punish. It is not that I do not know this man is not pure, it is there is a good reason to keep him. My keeping of [Dīng] Fěi is like a family having a thieving dog that yet excels at catching rats. Though the thefts are a small loss, yet it preserves my purse stores." Therefore restored [Dīng] Fěi's office, listening to and employing him as before. After several years he died of illness. [Dīng] Mì as a youth would not agree to socialize, only widely reading books and commentaries. As a many he was deep and resolute, and considerably had talent and strategy. During Tàihé, he once stayed at Yè, borrowed someone's empty room, resided inside it, but some kings also wished to borrow it, did not know [Dīng] Mì had already obtained it, and directly opened the gate to enter. [Dīng] Mì looked and saw the kings, laid down with crossed legs and did not rise, and called his slaves and retainers stating: "Who are these people? Quickly scold them to have them leave." the kings were angry at his lack of respect, returned and sent up report of his words. Emperor Míng arrested [Dīng] Mì, bound in Yè prison, but as he was an accomplished minister's son, pardoned and released him. Later the Emperor heard he had resemblance to his father, summoned and appointed him Limiting Expenses Cadet Central. Cáo Shuǎng had long been close with him, at the time when [Cáo] Shuǎng was Martial Guard General, he repeatedly praised him to the Emperor as capable of great use. It happened that the Emperor passed away, [Cáo] Shuǎng assisted in government, thust selected out [Dīng] Mì as Cavalier Regular Attendant, then transferred to Secretariat Writer. [Dīng] Mì as a man outside appeared careless and negligent but inside was often suspicious and calculating. When at the Terrace Pavillions, he repeatedly made impeachments and denunciations, those in the Terrace suffered from it, matters could not be enacted. Also he thought little of nobility, many were neglected by him, although he with Hé Yàn and Dèng Yáng and the rest were of the same rank, yet he thought little of them all, only due to power deferred to [Cáo] Shuǎng. [Cáo] Shuǎng also respected him, of his advice none was not followed. Therefore at the time there was a slanderous letter saying: "Inside the Terrace there are three dogs, two dogs snarling^[The term yá chái 崖柴 is a variant form of ái chái 啀喍, which refers to a dog opening its mouth and baring its fangs threateningly.] and cannot be matched, one dog relying on silence (Mò) to become an ulcer sack." Three dogs was speaking of Hé [Yàn], Dèng [Yáng], Dīng [Mì]. Mò (silence) was [Cáo] Shuǎng's childhood appellation. Its meaning was to say that the three dogs all wished to bite people, but [Dīng] Mì was the most extreme. Memorializing to send Dowager Empress Guō out to reside in a separate Palace, and sending the King of Lè'ān to go north to visit Yè, and also sending Wén Qīn to return to Huáinán, all were [Dīng] Mì's plans. Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng because of this especially deeply hated him.

Bì Guǐ appellation Zhāoxiān. His father appellation Zǐlǐ, during Jiàn'ān became a Managing Agriculture Colonel. [Bì] Guǐ for talent and ability from youth had fame. At the time when Emperor Míng was at the East Palace, [Bì] Guǐ was among his Literary Scholars. At Huángchū's end, he was sent out as a Chief Scribe. When Emperor Míng succeeded the throne, entered as a Yellow Gate Cadet, his son bestowed a princess, lived in prosperity and wealth. Promoted to Bìng Province Inspector. At Bìng Province he had a reputation for arrogance and indulgence. At the time miscellaneous caitiffs repeatedly made violence, harming clerks and civilians, [Bì] Guǐ at once sent out the army to strike Xiānbēi Kē Bǐnéng, was unsuccessful. Central Protector of the Army Jiǎng Jì memorialized stating: "Bì Guǐ's former failures are already past and need not be blamed, one only fears from this afterwards it is difficult to allow a repeat. Overall human talents have their strengths and shortcomings, and cannot be forced into success. [Bì] Guǐ's literary refinement and willful intention assuredly make him a fine vessel. Now in losing Bìng Province, he should be switched to be installed to another province, or enter to occupy a prominent position, to not defame his virtue, for state affairs it truly would be good. This is vital to security or danger, may Your Sagely Grace investigate it." Reaching to during Zhèngshǐ, he entered as Central Protector of the Army, transferred to Attendant Central Secretariat Writer, promoted to Director of Retainers Colonel. Formerly he was friendly with Cáo Shuǎng, every time in advising [Cáo] Shuǎng, many times it was followed.

Lǐ Shèng appellation Gōngzhāo. His father [Lǐ] Xiū appellation Zǐlǎng had wisdom and strategy. Zhāng Lǔ formerly was Defending North General, [Lǐ] Xiū was his Major, family at Nánzhèng. At the time Hànzhōng had sweet dew fall, Zǐlǎng saw Zhāng Lǔ had elite troops of several tens of thousands of men, had the firmness of a four-sided stronghold, and therefore established advice that the Red Aura had long declined, the Yellow House would rise, wishing for [Zhāng] Lǔ to claim title, [Zhāng] Lǔ did not listen. It happened that [Zhāng] Lǔ was defeated, Tàizǔ because he had urged [Zhāng] Lǔ to inwardly attach, bestowed noble title as Marquess Within the Passes, installed Irregular Office Cavalry Follower, to visit Yè. Reaching to during Huángchū, he served successively as Administrator of Shàngdǎng and Jùlù two prefectures, later due to old age returned, appointed Consultant Cadet. [Lǐ] Shèng in youth roamed the capital region, elegant and having talent and wisdom, friendly with Cáo Shuǎng. Emperor Míng banned the superficial and pretentious, and someone reported that [Lǐ] Shèng's halls had the Four Windows and Eight Convances, each having a designated name. Using this he was arrested, those that were connected and cited were many, therefore he obtained pardon, banned from office for several years. The Emperor passed away, Cáo Shuǎng assisted in government, [Lǐ] Shèng became Luòyáng Magistrate. When Xiàhóu Xuán became Campaigning West General, appointed [Lǐ] Shèng as his Chief Scribe. [Xiàhóu] Xuán also had long had a strong relationship with [Lǐ] Shèng. In the Luò valley campaign, many of the followed suggestions were produced by [Lǐ] Shèng, because of this Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng was displeased with [Lǐ] Shèng. Gradually promoted to Xíngyáng Administrator, Hénán Intendant. [Lǐ] Shèng beginning to end in his government administrations never once was not praised in office. He was Intendant for over a year, in front of the office the túsū was broken,^[The term túsū (Japanese pronunciation toso) is now more commonly used for a medicinal liquor served on the new year. The name is believed to have derived fron the name of an herb, and some building complexes would have a structure decorated with pictures of the túsū herb, and therefore be called túsū.] ordered people to again repair it, small timber of one piece suddenly fell, directly striking a receiving tally clerk Shí Hǔ's head, breaking it. Later in ten days he was promoted to Jīng Province Inspector, had not yet reached the office and was destroyed.

Huán Fàn appellation Yuánzé for generations was of dominant clan. At Jiàn'ān's end, he entered the Assistant Chancellor's Office. During Yánkāng, he became Feather Forest Left Overseer. As he had literary talent, with Wáng Xiàng and others he managed the compilation of the Huánglǎn. In Emperor Míng's time he became Central Manager of the Army and Secretariat Writer, promoted to Campaigning against Caitiffs General, East Central Cadet General, Envoy Holding Stave as Overall Supervisor of Qīng and Xú various military affairs, headquarters at Xiàpī. With Xú Province Inspector Zhèng Qí he fought over housing, drew his Stave wishing to behead [Zhèng] Qí, was memorialized against by [Zhèng] Qí as unjust, in connection was dismissed and returned. Reappointed as Yǎn Province Inspector, he was discontented and unable to obtain his wishes. Also he heard he was to be transferred to Jì Province Governor. At the time Jì Province was subordinate to the Defending North, and Defending North General Lǚ Zhāo in true talent and service advancement had originally been behind [Huán] Fàn. [Huán] Fàn spoke to his wife Zhòngcháng^[Zhòngcháng is a two-character family name.] stating: "I would rather be in the Ministers, only kneeling toward the Three Excellencies. I cannot bend to Lǚ Zǐzhǎn." His wife said: "You formerly were in the east, in connection to wishing to usurp authority to execute the Xú Province Inspector, everyone said you were difficult to serve as a subordinate. Now you are again ashamed to bend to Lǚ, it is to also be difficult to be your superior." [Huán] Fàn was arranged her words touched on the truth, and so with a saber pommel struck her abdomen. The wife at the time was pregnant, and therefore miscarried and died. [Huán] Fàn also indeed claimed illness, not going to Jì Province. During Zhèngshǐ he was appointed Minister of Agriculture. [Huán] Fàn formerly was at the Terrace Pavillions, acclaimed for understanding affairs, reaching to becoming Minister of Agriculture, he also for purity and frugality was praised. [Huán] Fàn once selected and compiled various miscellaneous events in the Hàn shū, by his own opinions edited it, titled as Shìyāo lùn ("Discourse on Essentials of the Age"). Jiǎng Jì was Grand Commandant, once with [Huán] Fàn gathered below the altars, the various ministers lined in seats were several people, [Huán] Fàn had his compilation in his bosom, wished to show it to [Jiăng] Jì, saying [Jiǎng] Jì would be open-minded and read it. [Huán] Fàn produced his book to show the Left and Right, the Left and Right passed it to show to [Jiǎng] Jì, [Jiǎng] Jì would not agree to look at it, [Huán] Fàn in his heart resented this. Taking advantage of a discussion of another matter, then he angrily spoke to [Jiǎng] Jì stating: "My ancestors were meager in virtue, but how can Your Excellency's generation compare?" Although [Jiǎng] Jì by nature was strong and resolute, he also knew [Huán] Fàn was stubborn and resolute, looked aside and did not answer, and each departed. When [Huán] Fàn was in Pèi prefecture his service sequence was after Cáo Zhēn. At the time Cáo Shuǎng assisted in government, as [Huán] Fàn was an elder of his hometown, among the Nine Ministers he was especially respectful to him, however they were not very close. Reaching to when [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng raised troops, closing the city gates, as [Huán] Fàn had understanding in affairs, thus directed to summon him, wishing to send him as designate Central Manager of the Army.^[This was a critical role in the coup: Central Manager of the Army was the position held by Cáo Shuǎng's own brother Cáo Xī.] [Huán] Fàn wished to answer the summons, but his son remonstrated him, believing as the Chariot Carriage was outside, it was not as good as going out south. [Huán] Fàn hesitated for a moment, and his son again hurried him. [Huán] Fàn wished to leave but the Minister of Agriculture's deputies and clerks all stopped [Huán] Fàn. [Huán] Fàn did not listen, and so rushed out to reach Píngchāng City Gate. The City Gate was already closed. Gate Guard Sī Fán was a former clerk recommended by [Huán] Fàn. [Huán] Fàn callled to him, raising a register in his hand to show him, falsely stating: "There is Edict summoning me, you quickly open the gates!" [Sī] Fán wished to request to see the Edict letter, [Huán] Fàn scolded him, saying: "Are you not my former clerk? How dare you act like this?" Thus opened it. [Huán] Fàn exited the city, turned back and spoke to [Sī] Fán stating: "The Grand Tutor plots rebellion, you follow us and go!" [Sī] Fán on foot travelled and could not catch up, and therefore stepped aside. [Huán] Fàn went south and met [Cáo] Shuǎng, urged [Cáo] Shuǎng and his brothers to have Heaven's Son visit Xǔchāng, and summon the Four Quarters to support themselves. [Cáo] Shuǎng was doubtful, [Cáo] Xī also did not speak. [Huán] Fàn himself spoke to [Cáo] Xī stating: "The situation is clear, what use was your reading of books for? Today your household has fallen!" Both did not speak. [Huán] Fàn again spoke to [Cáo] Xī stating: "Your separate camp is nearby to the south of the watchtowers, Luòyáng's Manager of Agriculture headquarters is outside the city walls, your calls and summons will be as you wish. Now to visit Xǔchāng is to not take more than a night, Xǔchāng's separate storehouses are sufficient for temporary supply. The only concern is in grain and provisions, but the seal and insignia of the Minister of Agriculture is on my person." [Cáo] Xī and his brothers were silent and did not follow this. In the middle of the night reaching the fifth watch,^[In ancient time keeping, the day was divided into twelve two-hour blocks. Of these, the fifth watch (wǔ gǔ) corresponds to the modern 3:00-5:00 AM.] [Cáo] Shuǎng then threw his saber to the ground, speaking to the various ministers following the Carriage stating: "I judge the Grand Tutor's intention is also no more than to wish to have me and my brothers submit to him. I alone have merely not accorded to the far and near." Therefore he advanced to speak to the Emperor stating: "Your Majesty should make an Edict to dismiss Your Servant from office, and reply to the Imperial Dowager Empress's Order." [Huán] Fàn knew if [Cáo] Shuǎng was first to request dismissal then he himself would certainly be connected to inciting an uprising. [Huán] Fàn thus said: "Old man that I am, now in connection to you brothers my clan is exterminated!" [Cáo] Shuǎng and the rest had been dismissed, the Emperor returned to the Palace, therefore ordered [Huán] Fàn to accompany. Arriving at the Luò river pontonn bridge's north, he looked out and saw [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng, dismounted charriage and knocked head and was without speech. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng called [Huán] Fàn by his surname stating: "Grandee Huán why be like this?" The Chariot Carriage entered the Palace, there was Edict for [Huán] Fàn to return and be restored to his position. [Huán] Fàn visited the watchtowers to bow and submit Reply of thanks, and waited for reply. It happened that Sī Fán had visited the Minister Herald to surrender himself, and entirely said what [Huán] Fàn had explained before setting out. [Sīmǎ Yì] Then was furious and said: "Falsely accusing someone of rebellion, by the law what is the answer?" The manager said: "By the law, they instead receive the punishment." Thus arrested [Huán] Fàn below the watchtowers. At the time the people grabbing [Huán] Fàn were extremely hurried, [Huán] Fàn spoke to the division officials stating: "Slow down, I also am merely a righteous serviceman." Therefore sent to the Minster of Justice.

Shìyǔ states: Previously, [Cáo] Shuǎng dreamed of two tigers holding the God of Thunder in their mouths, the God of Thunder resembling a two shēng bowl, released and placed in a courtyard. [Cáo] Shuǎng hated this, and asked a diviner about it. Língtái^[Língtái was the name of a terrace, often used for astronomical observation and astrology.] Deputy Mǎ Xùn said: "Worry of troops." [Mǎ] Xùn withdrew, and reported to his wife stating: "[Cáo] Shuǎng will by troops perish, in no more than ten days."

Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū states: Āndìng's Huángfǔ Mì in the Ninth Year winter dreamed of reaching Luòyáng, from a temple exiting, saw the chariots and riders were extremely many, with an object presented to the temple saying: "Executed General-in-Chief Cáo Shuǎng." He awoke and told this his villagers. The villagers said: "You wish to be the dreamer of the Cáo men? But what if the Court is without a Gōngsūn Qiáng?^[This is a reference to a story preserved in the Zuǒ Zhuàn Duke Āi Seventh Year. Someone in Cáo state dreamed of spirits gathering to plan the destruction of Cáo state. The spirit of Shūzhènduó, the founder of Cáo state, pleaded to wait until a Gōngsūn Qiáng came to power. Later, a commoner named Gōngsūn Qiáng indeed came to power and Cáo state was indeed conquered and destroyed.] Moreover [Cáo] Shuǎng and his brothers manage heavy troops, and also control Secretariat Writers affairs, who dares plan against them?" [Huángfǔ] Mì said: "[Cáo] Shuǎng is without Shūzhènduó's pleading,^[Shūzhènduó was the founder of Cáo state. In the story of the man dreaming of Cáo state's destruction, the spirit of Shūzhènduó pleaded on Cáo state's behalf.] if he loses Heaven's mechanisms then he is isolated, how can he rely on strength? In the past Hàn's Yán Xiǎn relied on the honor of the Mother Dowager, wielded power over the state's authority and mandates, what can be called the utmost heaviest, but castrates of nineteen people in one morning made him a corpse,^[When Hàn Emperor Ān died suddenly, his widow the Empress Yán and her brother Yán Xiǎn came to power as regents over a hastily enthroned child Emperor. When their child puppet suddenly died of illness, a group of nineteen eunuchs took advantage of the opening to launch a coup, killing Yán Xiǎn.] all the more for [Cáo] Shuǎng and his brothers."

Shìyǔ states: Previously, [Cáo] Shuǎng went out, his Major Lǔ Zhī remained at the office, heard there was a situation, commanded camp cavalry to chop through Jīn Gate to go out to go to [Cáo] Shuǎng. When [Cáo] Shuǎng was executed, he was selected out to be Censorate Central Deputy. When [Cáo] Shuǎng untied his seal and ribbon, about to go out, his Registrar Yáng Zōng stopped him stating: "Your Excellency holds the Ruler and grasps the reins,^[The word here is guàn 灌 "to irrigate, to pour" and is probably being used as a variant of jiāng 韁 "reins, bridle."], are you abandoning this to go to the East Market?"^[The East Market was the location of public executions.] [Cáo] Shuǎng did not follow this. Relevant managers memorialized that [Yáng] Zōng had directed [Cáo] Shuǎng to rebel, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng said: "Each has their master." Pardoned him, appointed Secretariat Writers Cadet. [Lǔ] Zhī appellation Shìyīng was a Fúfēng man. For later service he advanced to reach Specially Advanced Radiant Grandee. [Yáng] Zōng appellation Chūbó, later became Securing East General Sīmǎ [Zhāo] Wén-wáng's Chief Scribe.

Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Xiàhóu Zhàn's engraving for [Lǔ] Zhī and Gān Bǎo's Jìn jì both say that when [Cáo] Shuǎng was executed, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng then selected out [Lǔ] Zhī to be Bìng Province Inspector, and [Yáng] Zōng became Securing East Advisor to the Army. It is not in agreement with Shìyǔ.

〔一〕　魏略曰：鄧颺字玄茂，鄧禹後也。少得士名於京師。明帝時為尚書郎，除洛陽令，坐事免，拜中郎，又入兼中書郎。初，颺與李勝等為浮華友，及在中書，浮華事發，被斥出，遂不復用。正始初，乃出為潁川太守，轉大將軍長史，遷侍中尚書。颺為人好貨，前在內職，許臧艾授以顯官，艾以父妾與颺，故京師為之語曰：「以官易婦鄧玄茂。」每所薦達，多如此比。故何晏選舉不得人，頗由颺之不公忠，遂同其罪，蓋由交友非其才。丁謐，字彥靖。父斐，字文侯。初，斐隨太祖，太祖以斐鄉里，特饒愛之。斐性好貨，數請求犯法，輒得原宥。為典軍校尉，總攝內外，每所陳說，多見從之。建安末，從太祖征吳。斐隨行，自以家牛羸困，乃私易官牛，為人所白，被收送獄，奪官。其後太祖問斐曰：「文侯，印綬所在？」斐亦知見戲，對曰：「以易餅耳。」太祖笑，顧謂左右曰：「東曹毛掾數白此家，欲令我重治，我非不知此人不清，良有以也。我之有斐，譬如人家有盜狗而善捕鼠，盜雖有小損，而完我囊貯。」遂復斐官，聽用如初。後數歲，病亡。謐少不肯交游，但博觀書傳。為人沈毅，頗有才略。太和中，常住鄴，借人空屋，居其中。而諸王亦欲借之，不知謐已得，直開門入。謐望見王，交腳臥而不起，而呼其奴客曰：「此何等人？促呵使去。」王怒其無禮，還具上言。明帝收謐，繫鄴獄，以其功臣子，原出。後帝聞其有父風，召拜度支郎中。曹爽宿與相親，時爽為武衛將軍，數為帝稱其可大用。會帝崩，爽輔政，乃拔謐為散騎常侍，遂轉尚書。謐為人外似疏略，而內多忌。其在臺閣，數有所彈駮，臺中患之，事不得行。又其意輕貴，多所忽略，雖與何晏、鄧颺等同位，而皆少之，唯以勢屈於爽。爽亦敬之，言無不從。故于時謗書，謂「臺中有三狗，二狗崖柴不可當，一狗憑默作疽囊。」三狗，謂何、鄧、丁也。默者，爽小字也。其意言三狗皆欲嚙人，而謐尤甚也。奏使郭太后出居別宮，及遣樂安王使北詣鄴，又遣文欽令還淮南，皆謐之計。司馬宣王由是特深恨之。畢軌，字昭先。父字子禮，建安中為典農校尉。軌以才能，少有名聲。明帝在東宮時，軌在文學中。黃初末，出為長史。明帝即位，入為黃門郎，子尚公主，居處殷富。遷并州刺史。其在并州，名為驕豪。時雜虜數為暴，害吏民，軌輒出軍擊鮮卑軻比能，失利。中護軍蔣濟表曰：「畢軌前失，既往不咎，但恐是後難可以再。凡人材有長短，不可彊成。軌文雅志意，自為美器。今失并州，換置他州，若入居顯職，不毀其德，於國事實善。此安危之要，唯聖恩察之。」至正始中，入為中護軍，轉侍中尚書，遷司隸校尉。素與曹爽善，每言於爽，多見從之。李勝字公昭。父休字子朗，有智略。張魯前為鎮北將軍，休為司馬，家南鄭。時漢中有甘露降，子朗見張魯精兵數萬人，有四塞之固，遂建言赤氣久衰，黃家當興，欲魯舉號，魯不聽。會魯破，太祖以其勸魯內附，賜爵關內侯，署散官騎從，詣鄴。至黃初中，仕歷上黨、鉅鹿二郡太守，後以年老還，拜議郎。勝少游京師，雅有才智，與曹爽善。明帝禁浮華，而人白勝堂有四窗八達，各有主名。用是被收，以其所連引者多，故得原，禁錮數歲。帝崩，曹爽輔政，勝為洛陽令。夏侯玄為征西將軍，以勝為長史。玄亦宿與勝厚。駱谷之役，議從勝出，由是司馬宣王不悅於勝。累遷滎陽太守、河南尹。勝前後所宰守，未嘗不稱職，為尹歲餘，廳事前屠蘇壞，令人更治之，小材一枚激墮，正撾受符吏石虎頭，斷之。後旬日，遷為荊州刺史，未及之官而敗也。桓範字元則，世為冠族。建安末，入丞相府。延康中，為羽林左監。以有文學，與王象等典集皇覽。明帝時為中領軍尚書，遷征虜將軍、東中郎將，使持節都督青、徐諸軍事，治下邳。與徐州刺史鄭岐爭屋，引節欲斬岐，為岐所奏，不直，坐免還。復為兗州刺吏，怏怏不得意。又聞當轉為冀州牧。是時冀州統屬鎮北，而鎮北將軍呂昭才實仕進，本在範後。範謂其妻仲長曰：「我寧作諸卿，向三公長跪耳，不能為呂子展屈也。」其妻曰：「君前在東，坐欲擅斬徐州刺史，眾人謂君難為作下，今復羞為呂屈，是復難為作上也。」範忿其言觸實，乃以刀環撞其腹。妻時懷孕，遂墮胎死。範亦竟稱疾，不赴冀州。正始中拜大司農。範前在臺閣，號為曉事，及為司農，又以清省稱。範嘗抄撮漢書中諸雜事，自以意斟酌之，名曰世要論。蔣濟為太尉，嘗與範會社下，群卿列坐有數人，範懷其所撰，欲以示濟，謂濟當虛心觀之。範出其書以示左右，左右傳之示濟，濟不肯視，範心恨之。因論他事，乃發怒謂濟曰：「我祖薄德，公輩何似邪？」濟性雖彊毅，亦知範剛毅，睨而不應，各罷。範於沛郡，仕次在曹真後。于時曹爽輔政，以範鄉里老宿，於九卿中特敬之，然不甚親也。及宣王起兵，閉城門，以範為曉事，乃指召之，欲使領中領軍。範欲應召，而其子諫之，以車駕在外，不如南出。範疑有頃，兒又促之。範欲去而司農丞吏皆止範。範不從，乃突出至平昌城門，城門已閉。門候司蕃，故範舉吏也，範呼之，舉手中版以示之，矯曰：「有詔召我，卿促開門！」蕃欲求見詔書，範呵之，言「卿非我故吏邪，何以敢爾？」乃開之。範出城，顧謂蕃曰：「太傅圖逆，卿從我去！」蕃徒行不能及，遂避側。範南見爽，勸爽兄弟以天子詣許昌，徵四方以自輔。爽疑，羲又無言。範自謂羲曰：「事昭然，卿用讀書何為邪！於今日卿等門戶倒矣！」俱不言。範又謂羲曰：「卿別營近在闕南，洛陽典農治在城外，呼召如意。今詣許昌，不過中宿，許昌別庫，足相被假；所憂當在穀食，而大司農印章在我身。」羲兄弟默然不從，中夜至五鼓，爽乃投刀于地，謂諸從駕群臣曰：「我度太傅意，亦不過欲令我兄弟向己也。我獨有以不合于遠近耳！」遂進謂帝曰：「陛下作詔免臣官，報皇太后令。」範知爽首免而己必坐唱義也。範乃曰：「老子今茲坐卿兄弟族矣！」爽等既免，帝還宮，遂令範隨從。到洛水浮橋北，望見宣王，下車叩頭而無言。宣王呼範姓曰：「桓大夫何為爾邪！」車駕入宮，有詔範還復位。範詣闕拜章謝，待報。會司蕃詣鴻臚自首，具說範前臨出所道。宣王乃忿然曰：「誣人以反，於法何應？」主者曰：「科律，反受其罪。」乃收範於闕下。時人持範甚急，範謂部官曰：「徐之，我亦義士耳。」遂送廷尉。世語曰：初，爽夢二虎銜雷公，雷公若二升碗，放著庭中。爽惡之，以問占者，靈臺丞馬訓曰：「憂兵。」訓退，告其妻曰：「爽將以兵亡，不出旬日。」漢晉春秋曰：安定皇甫謐以九年冬夢至洛陽，自廟出，見車騎甚眾，以物呈廟云：「誅大將軍曹爽。」寤而以告其邑人，邑人曰：「君欲作曹人之夢乎！朝無公孫彊如何？且爽兄弟典重兵，又權尚書事，誰敢謀之？」謐曰：「爽無叔振鐸之請，苟失天機則離矣，何恃于彊？昔漢之閻顯，倚母后之尊，權國威命，可謂至重矣，閹人十九人一旦尸之，況爽兄弟乎？」世語曰：初，爽出，司馬魯芝留在府，聞有事，將營騎斫津門出赴爽。爽誅，擢為御史中丞。及爽解印綬，將出，主簿楊綜止之曰：「公挾主握灌，捨此以至東巿乎？」爽不從。有司奏綜導爽反，宣王曰：「各為其主也。」宥之，以為尚書郎。芝字世英，扶風人也。以後仕進至特進光祿大夫。綜字初伯，後為安東將軍司馬文王長史。臣松之案：夏侯湛為芝銘及干寶晉紀並云爽既誅，宣王即擢芝為并州刺史，以綜為安東參軍。與世語不同。

[Jiǎng] Jì also resented that his words had broken faith with [Cáo] Shuǎng, therefore fell ill and died.

〔二〕　干寶晉紀曰：蔣濟以曹真之勳力，不宜絕祀，故以熙為後。濟又病其言之失信于爽，發病卒。

#### Hé Yàn {.unnumbered #heyan}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Hé] Yàn was Hé Jìn's grandson. His mother Yǐn-shì became Tàizǔ's consort. [Hé] Yàn grew up in the Palace offices, also was bestowed a princess, from youth for his abundant talent was famed, enjoyed Lǎo-Zhuāng philosophy,^[Lǎo-zǐ was a Spring and Autumn era thinker, Zhuāng-zǐ a Warring States era thinker. Their work became the foundation for what is now called "Dào-ism" (Wade-Giles: Taoism).] wrote the Dào Dé lùn^["Discourse (lùn) on Way (dào) and Virtue (dé)"] and various essays, rhapsodies, and writings altogether several tens of fascicle. <a href="#annotation-36" id="source-36">[36]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
晏，何進孫也。母尹氏，為太祖夫人。晏長于宮省，又尚公主，少以才秀知名，好老莊言，作道德論及諸文賦著述凡數十篇。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-36" id="annotation-36">[36]</a> [Hé] Yàn appellation Píngshū.

Wèilüè states: At the time when Tàizǔ was Excellency of Works, he accepted (as concubine) [Hé] Yàn's mother and also adopted [Hé] Yàn, at the time Qín Yílù's son Ā'sū also accompanied his mother and was in the Excellency's house, both met with favor like the Excellency's sons. Sū was [Qín] Lǎng. [Qín] Sū by nature was cautious, but [Hé] Yàn was without any consideration or fears, his clothes and adornments imitated the Heir-Apparent, therefore Emperor Wén specially detested him, never calling him by family name or appellation, always calling him as "the adopted son." [Hé] Yàn was bestowed a princess, also enjoyed lechery, therefore in the time of Huángchū he was without duties or appointments. Reaching to Emperor Míng's establishment, he tended to be in the Redundant Officials.^[Redundant officials (rǒng guān) were government officials without designated regular duties or tasks, used for ad hoc tasks.] Reaching the beginning of Zhèngshǐ, he accomodated to Cáo Shuǎng, and also had talent and capability, therefore [Cáo] Shuǎng employed him as Cavalier Regular Attendant, promoted to Attendant Central Secretariat Writer. [Hé] Yàn formerly due to being bestowed a princess was able to be bestowed noble title as a Ranked Marquess, also his mother was inside (the Palace), [Hé] Yàn by nature was self-satisfied, whether moving or at rest white (makeup) powder did not leave his hand, while walking he looked back at his own shadow. [Hé] Yàn became a Secretariat Writer, managed selections and recommendations, of those that had former old relationships with him, many were selected out for promotion.

Wèi Mò zhuàn states: [Hé] Yàn's wife was the Princess of Jīnxiāng, [Hé] Yàn's younger (half) sister of the same mother.^[This scandalous accusation is probably false. See Péi Sōngzhī's comment below.] The princess was worthy, and spoke to her mother the King of Pèi's Dowager stating: "[Hé] Yàn evildoing daily grows more extreme, how will he protect himself?" Her mother laughed and said: "Are you perhaps jealous of [Hé] Yàn?" Shortly afterwards [Hé] Yàn died. He had one son, aged five to six years, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng sent someone to arrest him. [Hé] Yàn's mother took and hid the child inside the King's Palace, faced the envoy and beat her own cheeks, begging to spare him. The envoy reported the situation to [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng also had heard that [Hé] Yàn's wife had spoken with foresight, his heart always commended this, and moreover due to the King of Pèi, specially pardoned and did not kill.^[The biography of Féi Yī in SGZ 44 includes an annotation stating that Hé Yàn's son was indeed killed. If Wèi Mò zhuàn is not incorrect here, it is possible that "pardoned and did not kill" refers to Hé Yàn's wife (the King of Pèi's sister), not Hé Yàn's son.]

Wèi shì Chūnqiū states: Previously, Xiàhóu Xuán, Hé Yàn and others had fame flourishing at the time, Sīmǎ [Shī] Jǐng-wáng also participated with them. [Hé] Yàn once said: "'Only by depth is one therefore capable of understanding the will of Heaven's Under,' Xiàhóu Tàichū is this. 'Only by subtlety is one therefore capable of completing the tasks of Heaven's Under,' Sīmǎ Zǐyuán is this. 'Only by divinity, is to not hurry and yet be fast, to not walk and yet arrive,' I have heard of this saying, but not yet seen the person."^[The quotes are from the Xì Cí commentary in the Yìjīng, describing the aspects of a sage.] Probably he wished to use divinity to refer to himself. Previously, [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng had [Hé] Yàn participate in the investigation of the prison cases of [Cáo] Shuǎng and the rest. [Hé] Yàn exhaustively investigated the faction participants, hoping to by this obtain pardon. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng said: "Altogether there are eight clans." [Hé] Yàn listed Dīng and Dèng and the rest of seven surnames. [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng said: "Not yet." [Hé] Yàn was thoroughly anxious and so said: "Are you speaking of [me, Hé] Yàn?" [Sīmǎ Yì] Xuān-wáng said: "Yes." Thus arrested [Hé] Yàn.

Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Wèi Mò zhuàn says that [Hé] Yàn took his younger sister of the same mother as wife. This is something the gentry^[The term for "gentry" here is jìn shēn, literally "inserted through the sash," referring to how gentry officials would have ceremonial tablets inserted and tucked into their belt sashes.] would not bear to speak of, even the King of Chǔ taking as wife his brother's widow is not this extreme. Even if this report had been produced from an old history, yet still one would not believe it, all the more for a base and inferior book. According to the biographies of the various Kings and Dukes, the King of Pèi was begat by the Lady Dù. [Hé] Yàn's surname was Yǐn, if the princess with the King of Pèi were of the same mother, how could it be said she and [Hé] Yàn had the same mother?^[Note that the Lady Dù was the mother of Qín Lǎng, the other famous stepson adopted by Cáo Cāo. Probably Wèi Mò zhuàn confused the mothers of Hé Yàn and Qín Lǎng.]

Huángfǔ Mì's Liè Nǚ zhuàn states: [Cáo] Shuăng's younger cousin Wénshū's wife was Qiáo prefecture's Xiàhóu Wénníng's daughter, named Língnǚ. Wénshū early died, the mourning completed, she herself believed her years were few and she was without children, feared her family would certainly remarry her, and so cut her hair as a pledge. Afterwards her family indeed wished to marry her off, Língnǚ heard, and immediately again used a knife to cut her two ears, her residence always depended on [Cáo] Shuǎng. Reaching to when [Cáo] Shuǎng was executed, the Cáo clan was completely dead. Língnǚ's father's younger brother sent up letter to sever marriage ties with the Cáo clan, and forcefully welcomed Língnǚ to return home. At the time Wénníng was Liáng Chancellor, pitied her youth and maintaining of righteousness, and also the Cáo clan had no remaining survivors, hoped her intentions would end, and so secretly someone to hint to her. Língnǚ sighed and sobbed stating: "I also consider this, agreeing to it is correct." The family believed it true, and their guarding became slightly lax. Língnǚ thereupon secretly entered the bedroom, with a knife cut off her nose, covered with a quilt and lay down. Her mother called her to speak, she did not answer, lifting the quilt and seeing her, the blood flow filled the bed and mat. The entire family was alarmed and rushed to go see her, none were not aching in nose. Someone spoke to her stating: "A person's life in this world is like mere light dust perched on weak grass, why utmostly suffer like this? Moreover your husband's family is already exterminated completely, maintaining this desire is for whom?" Língnǚ said: "I have heard benevolence is to not by flourishing or decline change integrity, righteousness is not to by survival or destruction change heart. At the time when the Cáo clan was formerly flourishing, still I wished to maintain to the end, all the more now when declined and destroyed, how can I bear to abandon it? The conduct of birds and beasts, how can I do it?" Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng heard and commended this, listened to and permitted her request for a child to adopt to be the Cáo clan's posterity, her name famed in the world.

〔一〕　晏字平叔。魏略曰：「太祖為司空時，納晏母并收養晏，其時秦宜祿兒阿蘇亦隨母在公家，並見寵如公子。蘇即朗也。蘇性謹慎，而晏無所顧憚，服飾擬於太子，故文帝特憎之，每不呼其姓字，嘗謂之為「假子」。晏尚主，又好色，故黃初時無所事任。及明帝立，頗為冗官。至正始初，曲合于曹爽，亦以才能，故爽用為散騎侍郎，遷侍中尚書。晏前以尚主，得賜爵為列侯，又其母在內，晏性自喜，動靜粉白不去手，行步顧影。晏為尚書，主選舉，其宿與之有舊者，多被拔擢。魏末傳曰：晏婦金鄉公主，即晏同母妹。公主賢，謂其母沛王太妃曰：「晏為惡日甚，將何保身？」母笑曰：「汝得無妒晏邪！」俄而晏死。有一男，年五六歲，宣王遣人錄之。晏母歸藏其子王宮中，向使者搏頰，乞白活之，使者具以白宣王。宣王亦聞晏婦有先見之言，心常嘉之；且為沛王故，特原不殺。魏氏春秋曰：初，夏侯玄、何晏等名盛於時，司馬景王亦預焉。晏嘗曰：「唯深也，故能通天下之志，夏侯泰初是也；唯幾也，故能成天下之務，司馬子元是也；惟神也，不疾而速，不行而至，吾聞其語，未見其人。」蓋欲以神況諸己也。初，宣王使晏與治爽等獄。晏窮治黨與，冀以獲宥。宣王曰：「凡有八族。」晏疏丁、鄧等七姓。宣王曰：「未也。」晏窮急，乃曰：「豈謂晏乎！」宣王曰：「是也。」乃收晏。臣松之案：魏末傳云晏取其同母妹為妻，此搢紳所不忍言，雖楚王之妻（嫂）〔媦〕，不是甚也已。設令此言出于舊史，猶將莫之或信，況底下之書乎！案諸王公傳，沛王出自杜夫人所生。晏母姓尹，公主若與沛王同生，焉得言與晏同母？皇甫謐列女傳曰：爽從弟文叔，妻譙郡夏侯文寧之女，名令女。文叔早死，服闋，自以年少無子，恐家必嫁己，乃斷髮以為信。其後，家果欲嫁之，令女聞，即復以刀截兩耳，居止常依爽。及爽被誅，曹氏盡死。令女叔父上書與曹氏絕婚，彊迎令女歸。時文寧為梁相，憐其少，執義，又曹氏無遺類，冀其意沮，迺微使人諷之。令女歎且泣曰：「吾亦惟之，許之是也。」家以為信，防之少懈。令女於是竊入寢室，以刀斷鼻，蒙被而臥。其母呼與語，不應，發被視之，血流滿床席。舉家驚惶，奔往視之，莫不酸鼻。或謂之曰：「人生世間，如輕塵棲弱草耳，何至辛苦迺爾！且夫家夷滅已盡，守此欲誰為哉？」令女曰：「聞仁者不以盛衰改節，義者不以存亡易心，曹氏前盛之時，尚欲保終，況今衰亡，何忍棄之！禽獸之行，吾豈為乎？」司馬宣王聞而嘉之，聽使乞子字養，為曹氏後，名顯于世。
:::
